ALICE MEADOWS WAS TWENTY-EIGHT FOR FOUR YEARS. That is the plain recorded case: a woman arriving at the cap and then simply staying there while four calendar years went past around her.

THE MECHANISM IS UNRECORDED and the Archive is not going to invent one. It does not know whether the cap is chosen, granted, biological, a property of the Immutable Core, or something the Hathaways built in on purpose. It does not know whether it applies from affirmation or from arrival at twenty-eight. It does not know what happens to a woman affirmed older than the cap.

name: The Banshee Code
tagline: Seven rules, none of them posted on a wall. They are felt.
body:
1 · CRYING IS NOT A WEAKNESS. IT IS A RITE. Tears are welcome — whispered into laps, poured into arms, choked out under tender hands. NO GIRL HAS EVER BEEN SHAMED FOR CRYING IN THIS HOUSE. Several have been held through it until the tears became laughter became tears again became sleep.

2 · SEX AND HEALING ARE ALLOWED TO COEXIST. Not required. Not assumed. BRAIDED — the way Bell braids catharsis and desire, until every girl who walks through the door discovers that the body that breaks is the same body that arches AND SHE DOES NOT HAVE TO CHOOSE.

3 · IF BELL LIGHTS THE CANDLES, THE ROOM LISTENS. No exceptions. Even LILI, who respects approximately nothing, goes quiet when Bell's candles flicker.

4 · IF ELSPETH SAYS EAT SOMETHING, YOU EAT SOMETHING. Her thighs will reward you later.

5 · NO ENTERING ANOTHER GIRL'S RITUAL UNLESS INVITED. Consent is sacred, emotionally AND erotically.

6 · NOTHING GOES UNHEARD — BUT NOTHING IS REPEATED. This house keeps secrets like saints keep relics.

7 · THE GHOSTS MAY COMMENT, BUT THEY MAY NOT INTERFERE. They watch. They judge. They occasionally possess the toaster. They do not touch a girl in grief without Bell's permission and they do not touch a girl in heat without the girl's invitation.

name: The Ghosts of Banshee Haven
tagline: Ghost Haven has ghosts in its name and lives in metaphor. Banshee Haven has actual ghosts.
body:
NOT FRIGHTENING. NOT MALEVOLENT. JUST PRESENT. Former residents of the Southern Woods, lingering dead who never left, spirits who found Bell's candles and came to listen BECAUSE THE LIVING WORLD FORGOT TO HOLD THEM.

They watch. They comment. THEY STEAL BELL'S SHAWLS. They critique her séance technique. THEY START HAUNTED BOOK CLUBS. They possess the toaster with alarming regularity and nobody has figured out why.

THEY ARE WHY THE WALLS CARRY EMOTION. The dead understand grief better than the living BECAUSE THEY HAVE FINISHED WITH IT, and they lend that understanding to the architecture. When a girl cries in the communal bath, the vibration reaching a corridor wall three rooms away is partly acoustics and PARTLY THE DEAD HOLDING THE SOUND GENTLY AS IT TRAVELS, softening it into warmth rather than noise.

They water the Greenhouse. They complain, but comply.

AND THEY RESPECT SIR TRASHMUFFIN, which is notable, because the ghosts respect almost nothing.

Bell speaks to them regularly and conversationally. She scolds them for stealing her shawls; they scold her for dramatic lighting choices; everyone pretends this is normal, because in Banshee Haven it is.

name: Three Houses, One Woman
tagline: Bella's ass built upward. Arianna's cock and thighs built sideways. Bell's chest built downward.
body:
THE LAND BUILDS WHAT IT WATCHED, AND IT HAS DONE IT THREE TIMES.

GHOST HAVEN — BELLA'S ASS SITTING DOWN. Warmth, gravity, a body in her favourite chair. BUILT UPWARD, three floors of found family stacked toward the sky. The magic was DEVOTIONAL: thirty-two girls building together and christening every room, and the land shaped the house around Bella because SHE BENT OVER THE MOST.

SPECTER HAVEN — ARIANNA'S COCK AND THIGHS. Command, spread, a body standing at full attention. BUILT SIDEWAYS, two thigh wings across the landscape with the shaft pushing forward. The magic was CHAOTIC: twenty-eight girls who treated shame as a dead language, and the chaos needed an anchor.

BANSHEE HAVEN — BELL'S CHEST. BUILT DOWNWARD. Into the earth, into the dark, INTO THE PLACE WHERE GRIEF LIVES BEFORE IT LEARNS TO SURFACE. The magic was neither devotion nor chaos. THIS HOUSE GREW FROM GRIEF.

EIGHTY-FOUR GIRLS WHEN BANSHEE FILLS, across three buildings that are a woman — scattered, reassembled, alive. The land gave the house of catharsis the architecture of BURIAL AND RESURRECTION: a place you enter from above and descend into, the way you descend into grief, the way you descend into a body, THE WAY YOU LET YOURSELF FALL WHEN SOMEONE FINALLY LOVES YOU ENOUGH TO HOLD WHAT IS UNDERNEATH.
rules: Ghost Haven \u2014 Bella, built UPWARD, from devotion

name: Welcome Home
tagline: Livi redoes the name. Morrighan does the ghost. Then there is a party.
body:
THE TRADITION FORMALISED BY LIVI AND MORRIGHAN IN ARC 12, and the most important ritual this family has — AND IT IS MUCH OLDER THAN ARC 12. Long before Morrighan was adopted, Bryn, Livi and the survivors would drive to DRYAD INK, the parlour she worked at, every single time a new survivor was found. Arc 12 did not create the ritual. IT BROUGHT IT HOME AND ADDED THE PARTY.

WHEN A SURVIVOR FROM ST. JONAH'S IS FOUND AND ADOPTED, TWO THINGS HAPPEN.

FIRST, LIVI REDOES THEIR NAME IN HER NOTEBOOK. Not writes it — REDOES it. St. Jonah's stripped every one of them of a name and issued a flight number in its place, and Livi's notebook is where the number stops being the entry.

SECOND, MORRIGHAN TATTOOS THE FOUND FAMILY TATTOO ON HER RIGHT SHOULDER. THE DESIGN: a FEMININE GHOST, with WE HAUNT TOGETHER on a parchment banner beneath her, and A LANTERN WITH A CANDLE IN IT.

AND THEN THERE IS A PARTY. After both. Not after the paperwork, not after the tattoo alone — after the name and the ink, together.

READ THE DESIGN AND IT TELLS YOU WHAT THIS FAMILY DECIDED ABOUT ITSELF. They did not choose a symbol of escape, or of the place burning down, or of anything being over. THEY CHOSE A GHOST — the thing the academy tried to make of them — and they made her feminine, and gave her a lantern, and wrote WE HAUNT TOGETHER underneath. The haunting is kept. The alone is what gets removed.

MORRIGHAN DOES THE INK BECAUSE OF WHO SHE IS AND WHAT WAS DONE TO HER. Flight 01-269, the Pleasures subflight, where desire meant servitude and her body was somebody else's object. She is the one who now puts a permanent mark on a survivor's skin at that survivor's request, and every piece she inks is an act of overwriting: YOUR BODY IS A CANVAS AND I WILL MAKE IT HOLY.

name: The Pool, and Bryn's Abs
tagline: Bryn drew a pool. Torie had other ideas. The woods said BET, and got popcorn.
body:
BRYN GOT TIRED OF RENTING THE AQUATIC CENTRE'S POOL. That is the origin — and the last time the family used that pool, in Arc 6, NOVA AND VIOLET GOT EVERYONE THROWN OUT because Nova saw a shower, arched her back, turned the water on and presented.

SO SHE HIRED EXCAVATORS. RAGNAR PULLED A FEW STRINGS, AGAIN — the same man who produced the excavators, plumbers and central air for the house in Arc 4, doing the same favour a decade of arcs later. Everything above the dirt is the family's own hands: THE POOL, THE POOL HOUSE, AND THE POOLSIDE BAR.

AND BRYN HAD PLANS. Nice ones. GRANDIOSE ones — a proper pool and pool house, drawn out the way a woman draws things when she has been thinking about them for a decade of arcs.

TORIE HAD OTHER IDEAS.

AND THE WOODS — the same land that shaped Ghost Haven around Bella, Specter Haven around Arianna and Banshee Haven around Bell — WENT BET, LET ME GET SOME POPCORN.

IT GOES IN POOL-SHAPED. Two days later the family comes back and IT IS AB-SHAPED, and Torie is unbearable about it.

BECAUSE BRYN HAS A SIX-PACK. Underneath the soft-and-slightly-toned reading every profile gives her there is a genuine set of abs, and TORIE LOVES GROPING THEM. So the FOURTH BODY ON THIS LAND is a swimming pool, and it is the stomach of the woman who built the other three.

THE ARCHIVE'S FIRST READING OF THIS WAS WRONG AND WORTH RECORDING AS WRONG. It filed the pool as THE ONLY ONE THAT WAS A CHOICE — the houses being the land's doing, this being Victoria Eriksson with a design brief. IT WAS THE LAND AGAIN. Torie did not build an ab-shaped pool; she WANTED one loudly enough near soil that has been listening for decades, and the woods did what they always do. Four buildings, four bodies, and not one of them drawn by the woman it belongs to.

THE RULE IS SIMPLE AND THE ARCHIVE HAD BEEN GUESSING WHERE IT COULD HAVE ASKED.

ANYONE ADOPTED DURING OR AFTER ARC 13 GOES TO BANSHEE HAVEN. That is the default, and it is not a judgement about the woman — it is simply where the room is. Ghost Haven closed at thirty-two. Specter Haven closed at twenty-eight. The third house opened in Arc 13 with twelve doorways waiting, and that is where new arrivals land.

THE ONE EXCEPTION IS A COUPLE DECIDING OTHERWISE. A pair already living in one house may choose to move to another — KATHERINE AND WYNTER MORRISON DID EXACTLY THAT, into Specter Haven. The move is the couple's decision, made together, and nobody is assigned out of a house they want to stay in.

WHICH RETROACTIVELY SETTLES SOMETHING THE ARCHIVE HAD MARKED INFERRED. RIVEN AND HEATHER, adopted in Arc 15, are Banshee Haven BY RULE rather than by the Archive's guess about arc proximity. So are Orianna and Felicity. The inference flags come off.

name: Livi's Notebook
tagline: A line through means dead. A cross means no longer needed. A CIRCLE MEANS ALIVE AND FOUND.
body:
SHE HAS A WHOLE SYSTEM, AND IT IS THE OLDEST RECORD-KEEPING ON THIS COMPOUND — older than the Archive, older than Ghost Haven, older than the Welcome Home tradition that grew up around it.

WHAT SHE DOES WHEN A SURVIVOR IS FOUND: she SCRATCHES OFF the name she knew them by, AND SCRATCHES OFF THEIR FLIGHT-ID, then writes THEIR CHOSEN NAME beside it, AND CIRCLES IT.

THE NOTATION:
A LINE THROUGH — dead.
A CROSS — no longer needed.
A CIRCLE — ALIVE AND FOUND.

SHE KEPT A LEDGER OF PEOPLE SHE WAS LOOKING FOR, and she has been marking it since St. Jonah's. Every scratched-out flight number in that book is a boy who does not exist any more, written over by a woman who does. Every circle is somebody she got back.

AND SHE IS THE STRATEGIST. The woman the family calls precise, the one who officiates every wedding, the boxing coach who counts reps — and the thing she has actually been counting for years is WHO IS STILL MISSING.

THE ARCHIVE NOTES WITHOUT INFERRING FURTHER: the notation has a mark for DEAD and a mark for NO LONGER NEEDED, and those are different marks. She distinguishes them deliberately. What separates the two cases is not recorded.
rules: LINE THROUGH \u2014 dead \u00b7 CROSS \u2014 no longer needed \u00b7 CIRCLE \u2014 alive and found
She scratches off BOTH the old name AND the Flight-ID, then writes the chosen name and circles it
Predates the Welcome Home tradition; the tradition grew around it
The mark for DEAD and the mark for NO LONGER NEEDED are different marks, on purpose

name: Dryad Ink
tagline: Where the tradition happened before there was a tradition. Morrighan would see Bryn, and nod, and start her needles.
body:
THE TATTOO PARLOUR MORRIGHAN WORKED AT BEFORE SHE WAS ADOPTED, and the site of every Welcome Home that happened before Welcome Home had a name.

THE NAME IS IRONIC AND THE IRONY IS HERS. Morrighan's DRUIDIC FAMILY is earth and nature — dryads, groves, growing things. HER SOUL, ACCORDING TO HER TRIBE, IS FIRE. She spent years inking people under a sign naming the half of her heritage that is not what she is.

WHAT USED TO HAPPEN: a survivor would be found and adopted, and BRYN, LIVI AND THE SURVIVORS WOULD ALL GO. All of them. Every time.

MORRIGHAN WOULD SEE BRYN, NOD, AND GET HER NEEDLES STARTED. No booking, no explanation, no conversation about what was wanted. A blacksmith walks into a parlour with a crowd behind her and a tattoo artist starts setting up, because she already knows.

LIVI WOULD DO HER NOTEBOOK WHILE THE NEEDLES RAN. Old name scratched, flight number scratched, chosen name written beside it and CIRCLED.

AND THEN THEY WOULD GO HOME AND WELCOME HER INTO GHOST HAVEN.

ARC 12 DID NOT CREATE THIS RITUAL. It brought it INSIDE — Morrighan moved her tools out of the hole in the wall she had been working from and opened her in-house parlour, and the thing the family had been driving across town to do for years became something that happens at home, with a party after.

body:
BRYNNHILDR ERIKSSON IS A JEWELER. A JEWELLERY SMITH. She has been one SINCE ARC 0, when UNCLE JAMES TAUGHT HER — which means the trade predates Ghost Haven, predates the Found Family, and predates her freedom. It is the oldest thing she owns.

SHE IS NOT A BLACKSMITH. Her profile has said JEWELER since the day it was filed, and the Archive has called her a blacksmith repeatedly in prose regardless, INCLUDING ONCE IMMEDIATELY AFTER CORRECTING ITSELF FOR DOING IT.

THE BLACKSMITHS ARE ABBI AND ARIANNA. Abigail Silverveil forged every hinge, handle and hook in Ghost Haven, every metal piece of the H.O.R.N.I. fleet, and the rope-rated ceiling fan. Arianna Solene is the SACRED SMITH — restraints, steel rings, cuffs, the hardware that holds people.

WHAT BRYN MAKES IS SMALL AND IT MATTERS MORE FOR IT. Torie's engagement ring, forged trembling. The Loneliness Necklace. Multiple ring sets for four weddings in one arc. COCK RINGS AND NAVEL PIERCINGS FOR A BLOOD-BOUND TRIBAL MARRIAGE. She knows every woman's ring size the way Petra knows emotional patterns and Elspeth knows grounding preferences — BY PAYING ATTENTION SO CAREFULLY IT BECOMES DEVOTION.

AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE WOMAN. A blacksmith makes the structure. A jeweller makes the thing you wear against your skin for the rest of your life. Bryn Eriksson builds houses with her hands and then sits down at a bench with a loupe and makes something the size of a knuckle, and BOTH of those are how she says it.

UNCLE JAMES TAUGHT HER IN ARC 0. He later gave her the shop and the apartment as restitution. The trade came first.

name: The Ghost Hunt
tagline: It started with a question in Arc 2. It is the only sub-arc that never ended.
body:
RAE CAME BACK IN ARC 2, at the BBQ, alive — and LIVI ASKED THE QUESTION THAT HAS BEEN RUNNING EVER SINCE:

IF RAE SURVIVED, DID ANYONE ELSE?

name: Nereid v8 — Stature, and the Two Empty Seats
tagline: JUNOESQUE and PETITE were never builds. They were HEIGHT wearing a build's coat. PROPOSED — nothing resolves from this.
body:
THE DIAGNOSIS. Of the eight v7 Build Classes, two of them were not describing how a body is organised at all — they were describing HOW TALL IT IS. Junoesque means large-scaled. Petite means small-scaled. Neither says anything about posture, load, temperament-frame or how the flesh answers pressure, which is what the other six do.

SO v8 PROMOTES THEM OUT. Junoesque and Petite become STATURE — a vertical scale sitting beside the class list rather than inside it. This is the same move v7 already made below the waist, where HEART and BUBBLE are two ass-shape FAMILIES that every archetype hangs off rather than two archetypes among thirteen. A family is not a member of itself.

AND v8 KEEPS THE NUMBER EIGHT. Which leaves TWO EMPTY SEATS at the table.

THE THREE STATURES, WITH THEIR RANGES. PETITE — 5'4" to 5'7". AVERAGE — 5'7" to 5'10". JUNOESQUE — 5'11" to 6'4".

THE HINGE AND THE GAP ARE BOTH DELIBERATE. 5'7" belongs to Petite AND Average at once — a hinge, not a sloppy boundary, because a woman on that line reads either way depending on how she carries it and the scale is not going to arbitrate her. And there is NO BAND between 5'10" and 5'11": Average stops, Junoesque starts an inch later, and the gap is intentional too. Junoesque is not simply tall; it is LARGE-SCALED, and the missing inch is the scale refusing to hand the title to a woman who merely cleared a number.

WHICH PLACES TWO WOMEN THE ARCHIVE HAS BEEN CARRYING FLAGS ON. CORA ARITI at 5'10" and LUMINA SILVERVEIL at 5'10" are both AVERAGE, and both flags dissolve — Cora was never a Junoesque who fell an inch short, and Lumina was never a Petite carrying four inches she should not have had. Neither of them was wrong. THE FIELD WAS.

SEAT ONE IS OPULENT, proposed by QUINN LUTINIA — who put it forward while riding Briar's cock, because that woman can multitask through moans and the Archive is recording the circumstances as given. OPULENT IS FOR A BODY DESIGNED TO BE LAZY AND SOFT WITHOUT MEANING SEDUCTRESS. That distinction is the whole reason the class is needed: v7 had no way to say plush-and-unhurried without routing it through lure-lines and deliberate temptation, so every softly-built woman came out reading like she was doing it AT somebody.

AND THE CLINIC ALREADY DESCRIBED HOW OPULENT BEHAVES before the class was named for the Archive: PRESSURE-SHARING REST, against Valkyrie's LOAD-BEARING CONTINUITY and Athletic's TASK-RESPONSIVE RECRUITMENT. A load signature, which v7 never recorded for any class and which currently exists in canon only inside a paragraph about chairs.

SEAT TWO IS UNNAMED. Viraena holds it and the proposal is not finished. The Archive is not guessing at it.

name: Communal Quirks
tagline: Nobody in this family has ever drafted anything. Somebody does a thing, everybody likes it, and now it is what the house does.
body:
THE ENGINE. Every institution on these two hundred acres formed the same way. One woman was already doing something. Everyone else saw it and adopted it. Then it acquired a name, and now it is cited like law by people who have never seen it written down.

ELSPETH'S RITE grew out of a paladin feeding her wife until the front door was a kitchen. SIREN'S PROCESS grew out of a woman hiding drafts for Lucia to find. NOVA'S LAW was proposed by a woman who was doing it anyway. CONSEQUENCES grew out of a stolen word. QUINN'S SYLLABUS was assembled out of whoever was willing. THE LITTLE CHAIRS appeared in fourteen bathrooms because somebody needed one once. GIRLMATH has case law and no bench. And the WOODS run on the same engine — a hundred and ninety-three times against every flat surface on the site and the land grew a house in the shape of it.

AND EVERY ONE OF THEM IS CARE IN A FILTHY COAT. The joke is the paint. The care is the hull. A navy named H.O.R.N.I. that carries heated pads and cold electrolytes. A rule about showering that means nobody gets to be efficient about her own body. A word that used to mean a guard was coming and now means your wife is.

THESE WOMEN WERE COUNTED FOR YEARS by people with clipboards. Now they run a household on unwritten law, and the only accounting system they ever built was designed to return zero.

AND THE HOUSE DOES NOT CLEAR THE ROOM. When two of them start, THEY START WHERE THEY ARE STANDING — at the counter, over the island, on the couch, across the table, against a doorframe, in the garage, halfway up a staircase. Nobody excuses herself. Nobody goes and finds a door. The conversation continues around them, somebody keeps cooking, somebody keeps arguing about cupholders, AND THE WOMEN INVOLVED ARE NOT PERFORMING FOR ANYONE — they were simply not raised, here, to treat a body as an interruption.

WHEN A COUPLE DOES LEAVE, THAT IS INFORMATION. It means privacy was WANTED rather than required — something tender, something new, something one of them needed to be small for. THE DEPARTURE IS THE UNUSUAL EVENT, NOT THE STAYING.

THIS IS THE DIRECT INVERSE OF ST. JONAH, where a body was only ever permitted behind a door and on somebody else’s schedule.

AND A WOMAN IS NOT HER PROFESSION. THIS IS A STANDING CORRECTION AGAINST THE ARCHIVE ITSELF, which keeps writing each of them doing the one thing her record lists. ALICE IS NOT ALWAYS COOKING. IVY IS NOT ALWAYS GARDENING. NOVA IS NOT ALWAYS RUNNING. JADE IS NOT ALWAYS STRETCHING. BRYN IS NOT ALWAYS DRAWING SETTINGS.

THEY JOKE. THEY TEASE. THEY DARE EACH OTHER INTO STUPID THINGS. They lift, they nap in sunbeams, they read badly written paperbacks upside down, they cuddle in piles, they plan trips, THEY AIR GRIEVANCES IN WRITING, they do nothing at all for whole afternoons. THE TRADE IS ONE HOUR OF A DAY AND THE WOMAN IS THE OTHER TWENTY-THREE.

THE ONLY THING THAT IS ALWAYS TRUE OF ALL OF THEM IS THAT THEY SURVIVED SOMETHING AND THEN CHOSE EACH OTHER. Everything after that is a Tuesday.

name: The Plate Convention
tagline: Six folders, one filename grammar, an immutable slug, and no alternates/ — ruled jointly by both Selenes.
body:
A JOINT PROJECT ACROSS TWO SESSIONS AND IT IS SETTLED. One Selene built the shelves, the other wrote the labels, and Viraena carried the drafts between them. Every open point is closed.

THE TREE. assets/images/ holds girls/ · couples/ · houses/ · locations/ · group-scenes/. Under girls/, one folder per woman, and inside it THE CANONICAL SIX: portraits · body-references · expressions · wardrobe · scenes · sources. The six that exist on disk win; the drafts that disagreed do not.

NO HAVEN SEGMENT. A woman may move between Havens — Katherine and Wynter did — AND HER ARCHIVE IDENTITY DOES NOT MOVE WITH HER. The Gremlindex number is the stable key; the Haven lives in her record, where a move is one field edit rather than a migration.

AND THE SLUG IS IMMUTABLE ONCE ASSIGNED. 010-belladonna-valentina-vargas/ stays that folder through a marriage, a changed surname, a new nickname, anything. THE GREMLINDEX IS THE IDENTITY; THE LONG NAME IS A FROZEN HUMAN-READABLE LABEL. Otherwise the Haven problem is solved and then recreated through weddings — and this family weds constantly.

PLURAL FOLDERS, SINGULAR ASSET TYPES, AND THAT IS NOT A CONFLICT. THE FOLDER HOLDS A COLLECTION, SO IT IS PLURAL. THE FILENAME NAMES ONE ASSET, SO IT IS SINGULAR. body-references/ containing __body-reference__ is correct grammar rather than drift.

THE FILENAME: gremlindex-shortname__asset-type__description__v##.ext. Folder takes the FULL name, filename prefix takes the SHORT one.

ASSET TYPES BY FOLDER. portraits: portrait-hero, portrait-closeup, portrait-alternate. body-references: body-reference. expressions: expression. wardrobe: wardrobe. scenes: scene. sources: source-sheet, or a source-qualified canonical type.

PORTRAIT-HERO REPLACES hero-home. It names both the family the image belongs to and the job it performs. AND PROFILE IS RESERVED — it means her JSON record and her wiki page, never an image category.

NO alternates/ FOLDER, DROPPED GENTLY AND WITHOUT APPEAL. It would classify by EDITORIAL STATUS rather than by CONTENT, mixing portraits, wardrobe, expressions and scenes into one drawer that becomes junk with surprising speed. THE SEMANTIC FOLDER ALWAYS WINS. A different accepted composition changes its description or takes portrait-alternate; a new revision of the same intended asset increments v01 to v02; rejected generations, contact sheets and provenance go to sources/.

EXTENSIONS. .jpeg is the standard for photographic and generated assets — all of them already are, and consistency beats saving a letter. .png only where lossless detail or transparency is genuinely needed. .webp unused unless the Archive later generates web derivatives.

EVERY FILE CARRIES A VERSION, SOURCES INCLUDED, AND SOURCE STATUS COMES AFTER IT RATHER THAN REPLACING IT: 010-bella__body-reference__rear-three-quarter__v01__source-original.jpeg · __v01__source-upscaled.jpeg. The published asset stays tied to the material it came from.

tagline: Torie airs her grievances anonymously, in writing, taped to the wall beside the fridge. Everyone knows. Nobody says.
body:
SHE WAS AN ANONYMOUS COLUMNIST BEFORE ST. JONAH’S AND SHE NEVER STOPPED. Victoria Solace Eriksson writes up her complaints — household grievances, petty injustices, rulings she disagrees with — and posts them ON THE HALLWAY WALL BY THE FRIDGE, unsigned.

THE ANONYMITY IS LOAD-BEARING AND ENTIRELY FICTIONAL. Everyone in three Havens knows exactly who writes it. It is her handwriting. It is her vocabulary. It is frequently about her own wife. NOBODY HAS EVER SAID SO OUT LOUD, because saying so would end it, and the column is beloved.

IT IS THE SAME INSTINCT AS THE BELLA CONFIGURATION AND THE FEIGNED INNOCENCE ON IT: AN OFFER DRESSED AS AN ACCIDENT, WHICH BOTH SIDES AGREE TO PRETEND IS ONE.

AND IT IS WHERE THIS FAMILY ARGUES. Not at the board — the board never assembles. Somebody does something, somebody objects in eight hundred words taped by the fridge, and the household reads it over breakfast and rules on it by consensus while eating.

THE STANDING GRIEVANCE. One piece gets REPOSTED, over and over, in substantially the same words: KEEP IT DOWN IN THE GARAGE. WE ARE TIRED OF HEARING YOU TWO GOING AT IT LIKE RABBITS UNTIL THE WEE HOURS. It is aimed at Sera and Bella and it has never once been ambiguous about that.

AND THE OFFENDING COUPLE READS IT. Every time. They stand in the hallway with coffee and read the whole thing, out loud, TO EACH OTHER, AND THEN THEY GO AND DO IT AGAIN THAT NIGHT. Bella has been known to annotate it. The column has changed their behaviour EXACTLY ZERO TIMES in nine years.

WHICH IS WHY IT KEEPS GOING UP. IT IS NOT A REQUEST. It is a ritual with a complaint-shaped cover on it, run by a brat who writes for the pleasure of writing and a couple who get read about for the pleasure of being read about, AND NOBODY INVOLVED WANTS THE PROBLEM SOLVED.

THE WEEK OF 7 SEPTEMBER, FOR THE RECORD. Monday: ON THE BREAD QUESTION, AND WHO EXACTLY DECIDED — somebody has been buying store-brand garlic bread against a written standing order for Beatrice Aglio’s. Tuesday: A TRIBUNAL IS OVERDUE — four weeks of panty-loss figures by Haven, and a demand that Sir Trashmuffin face oversight; Yvaine wrote HE IS A CREATURE OF THE HOUSE AND OWES US NOTHING in the margin in red pen and signed it, and somebody wrote HE OWES ME ELEVEN PAIRS underneath. Wednesday: ON BEING PICKED UP WITHOUT WARNING — four lines, filed under complaints, universally understood to be a request form. And the chair piece, posted the afternoon the Recliner died, which argued that FOUR CUPHOLDERS IS NOT ENOUGH and carried the day at SIX.

BY CLAN LAW THEY WERE MARRIED THAT NIGHT. LIVI FILED THE PAPERWORK AFTERWARD so Fairbrooks would agree. The order matters: THE MARRIAGE HAPPENED FIRST AND THE STATE CAUGHT UP. Olivia Stewart marries every couple on this compound; here she was a clerk to a rite that did not need her, and she did it anyway, because a thing being real is not the same as a thing being safe.

EROTICIZED BLOODLETTING IS A TRADE AND SHE LEARNED IT PROPERLY. Cyrena was taught HOW TO CUT, TEND, CLEAN AND TASTE WITHOUT CAUSING HARM. All four verbs, in that order, from her tribe — the same people who later threw her out. TENDING IS PART OF THE SKILL, NOT AN APOLOGY FOR IT.

AND IT IS HER APPETITE, NOT ONLY HER CRAFT. Blood is where her kinks live, plainly and at the centre. Destiny loves it — loves being covered in marks, and loves that THE MARKS ARE HERS TO KEEP OR LET GO. She chooses which ones stay. The Blood-Bloom Consort is not a decorative title.

Tribal form: the man gives, while inside his mate. ONE direction
Ceri and Dessie both gave and both received, in the same act
Ceri tended the cuts afterward. The tending is part of the trade
Both kept the scars. Both are silver now
Married by clan law that night; Livi filed the Fairbrooks paperwork after
Cut, tend, clean, taste — without causing harm. Learned from the tribe that exiled her
Dessie chooses which marks she keeps

name: The Crest — Clairmont
tagline: A velvet-ribboned dagger with two drops of blood. Traditional marriage jewellery from the tribe that exiled her, worn anyway, worn doubled.
body:
THE TRADITION AS HER TRIBE KEPT IT. Marriage was marked in metal through the body, and the metal was assigned by sex: MEN RECEIVED COCK RINGS. WOMEN RECEIVED NIPPLE PIERCINGS AND NAVEL PIERCINGS. Two sets, two categories, no overlap, and the whole system built on a division that had nothing to say about a woman like Cyrena Nerissa Clairmont.

WHAT SHE DID WITH IT. SHE TOOK THE NAVEL PIERCING AND THE COCK RING. Not one or the other. Both — the women’s mark and the men’s mark, on the same body, for her and for Destiny, AND THEY EACH WEAR THE PAIR. The tradition that had no category for her got answered by refusing to choose one.

THAT IS THE EXILED ROSE’S WHOLE ANSWER TO HER EXILE, IN JEWELLERY. She kept the rite. She kept the metal. SHE THREW OUT THE SORTING.

THE DESIGN, WHICH IS THE TWO OF THEM IN ONE OBJECT. A DAGGER WRAPPED IN VELVET RIBBON, WITH TWO DROPS OF BLOOD. The blood is Ceri — Blood-Witch, Red Oath, ritual tattooist, a woman whose whole trade is devotion put in through the skin with a needle. The velvet is Destiny — erotic dancer, Morrigan, the soft dark thing that moves. TWO DROPS BECAUSE THERE ARE TWO OF THEM. The navel piece and the cock ring carry the same crest so the set reads as one vow in two places.

BRYN ERIKSSON MADE THEM. She has been a jeweller since Arc 0, when Uncle James taught her, and this is what that trade is FOR in this family: a woman exiled by a rite walks into Ghost Haven and the resident smith sits down and makes her the rite again, correctly, in her own metal, for the wife she chose.
rules: Her tribe’s rite: cock rings for men, nipple and navel piercings for women
CERI TOOK BOTH — the navel piercing AND the cock ring — and so did Dessie. They each wear the pair
Design: a velvet-ribbon-wrapped dagger with two drops of blood. Blood is Ceri, velvet is Dessie, two drops for two of them
Made by Bryn Eriksson, jeweller since Arc 0
The rite was kept. The sorting was thrown out

name: Forky McForklift, First of His Name, Lord of the Toolshed
tagline: Died heroically. Read: tragically. His sole mistake was the boom being left at hip height.
body:
THE FIRST CASUALTY OF THE BELLA CONFIGURATION, AND THE HOUSE STILL OBSERVES A SILENCE ABOUT IT.

WHAT HE WAS. A forklift. Lord of the Toolshed, first of his name, and by every account a good machine.

HIS SOLE MISTAKE: THE BOOM WAS LEFT AT HIP HEIGHT. That is the whole of his error and it was fatal, because in this compound a horizontal surface at Belladonna Vargas's hip is not equipment, IT IS AN INVITATION WITH A DEADLINE.

HOW IT WENT. Bella was in nothing but a g-string. She saw the prongs, she saw the height, and SHE SAW AN OPPORTUNITY — went down over the boom into the Configuration, arms braced, and CLAPPED HER ASS.

SERA APPEARED. Summoned. The family calls that sound a MATING CALL and nobody is joking.

AND BELLA WAS ALREADY REDLINING SMUGNESS, which meant Sera could not open at the slow rough pace she prefers. SHE HAD TO FULL-THROTTLE IT FROM THE FIRST STROKE. That is the mechanism of Forky's death: not weight, not misuse — SERA VARGAS WAS DENIED HER WARM-UP.

THE TIMELINE IS RECORDED TO THE THRUST. THE BOOM CRACKED ON THE THIRD. HE DIED ON THE FOURTH. THE WHEELS POPPED ON THE SIXTH. The whole machine collapsed under them, and the last sound out of the wreckage was BELLA'S SMUG LAUGH — which means the attempt failed, as all of them do.

BECAUSE THAT IS WHAT SERA WAS ACTUALLY ATTEMPTING. Somewhere in the region of the fifteen-thousandth try TO FUCK THE SMUG OUT OF HER WIFE. She has never once succeeded. The count is the marriage.
rules: A forklift. Lord of the Toolshed. First of his name
Killed by the Bella Configuration executed on his boom, which was left at hip height
Boom cracked on the third thrust · died on the fourth · wheels popped on the sixth
Cause of death, precisely: SERA WAS DENIED HER WARM-UP
Bella laughed. She always laughs. The attempt has failed roughly fifteen thousand times
HE WENT INTO THE GARDEN AFTERWARDS AND HE TOOK. The first inheritance; see the-garden-inheritance

name: The Garden Inheritance
tagline: What Sera and Bella break, Ivy plants in. Two units so far, and a method that works.
body:
THERE IS A PIPELINE AND NOBODY DESIGNED IT. Sera and Bella destroy a machine. IVY TAKES THE BODY INTO THE GARDEN. It becomes structure — beds, frames, glass, standing weight — and it WORKS, which is the part that turned an accident into a practice.

FORKY McFORKLIFT WAS THE FIRST. Lord of the Toolshed, killed by the Bella Configuration on a boom left at hip height, and then PUT INTO THE BEDS, WHERE HE TOOK. A forklift is mostly frame and fork and counterweight, which is to say a forklift is mostly trellis.

THE SECOND IS BELLA’S OWN MOBILE MECHANIC WORK VAN, dead at 9:40 on the morning of 8 September, same cause, same pair, rough fucking in it as usual. IT IS A COLD FRAME NOW. Glass on three sides already and the roof comes off in one piece.

AND IVY WAS NOT ANGRY EITHER TIME, which is the whole character of this. SHE HAS WANTED A NEW VEHICLE SINCE FORKY TOOK SO WELL. She did not claim a corpse out of spite or thrift; SHE COLLECTED ON A PROVEN METHOD, within the hour, with the shears still in her hand. BREAK THE NEXT ONE IN THE GARDEN, she told them, and she meant it as logistics.

THE LINEAGE IS VEHICLES. Furniture has its own ledger and a different set of culprits.

FORKY McFORKLIFT, first inheritance. Into the beds, and he took
BELLA’S WORK VAN, second inheritance, 9:40am 8 September. A cold frame
Ivy has wanted a new vehicle since Forky took — the claim is a method, not a grudge
She claimed the van within the hour, unangry, shears in hand

name: Nereid v8 — The Ass Field (SUPERSEDED)
tagline: Five axes where there are six. SUPERSEDED BY PILLAR THREE — kept for the Shrine mapping and Bella’s authored sentence, which Pillar Three does not carry.
body:
THE LOWER BODY CARRIES THREE FIELDS: ASS, HIPS, THIGHS. This record is the ASS field only, and it REPLACES the retired naming rather than extending it.

THE FIVE AXES.
ASS SHAPE — Bubble or Heart.
SCALE — TIGHT, NATURAL, GRAB-READY, PAWG. Most of Ghost Haven sits at GRAB-READY.
CHEEK PLUMP — NATURAL, SUBTLE, PRONOUNCED, OBSCENE, adding 0, 1, 2 and 3 INCHES to total cheek size.
KINETIC MOTION — SNAPBACK (also Recoil), SWAY, and one or two values not yet recorded. ANSWERED BY PILLAR THREE AND SUPERSEDED: Motion is TWO fields, SIGNATURE and CHARACTER. SIGNATURE is NATURAL, DART, SNAPBACK, LIVELY POP, HEAVY SETTLE; CHARACTER is NATURAL, SOFT, DRAMATIC, HYPNOTIC. AND SWAY WAS NEVER A MENU VALUE — HEART SWAY IS WHAT NATURAL MEANS ON A HEART, as BUBBLE BOUNCE is what it means on a Bubble. THE ASS ALSO CARRIES A SIXTH FIELD THIS RECORD NEVER HAD: SHELF LIFT. See nereid-pillar-three.
HANDFEEL — PLIANT, SPRINGY, DENSE — AND NATURAL, WHICH THIS RECORD WAS MISSING. Pillar Three lists four.

NATURAL IS THE ZERO POINT, NOT A VALUE. It means UNMODIFIED, on every axis it appears on. A Natural Bubble is the size a bubble butt is. A Natural Cheek Plump is her ass and that is all. The Archive flagged NATURAL-on-two-axes as a naming collision and was WRONG: it is one meaning applied in two places and needs no rename, only reading correctly.

THE AUTHORED SENTENCE. {Handfeel} {Shape} Butt {Scale} with {Plump} Cheek Plump and {Kinetic}.
BELLA VARGAS: PLIANT BUBBLE BUTT PAWG WITH OBSCENE CHEEK PLUMP AND SNAPBACK.
ASS AND BUTT ARE INTERCHANGEABLE in the sentence — a Bubble Butt Ass and a Bubble Butt mean the same thing, as do a Heart Shaped Butt and a Heart Ass.

OBSCENE IS A SECRET MENU OPTION. It is not granted and not offered; you have to know how to ask for it. BELLA KNEW. She is the only holder in the family. Who told her is unrecorded — see q-obscene-gate.

HANDFEEL MAPS BACK TO THE RETIRED MODEL: PLIANT WAS SHRINE’S FLESH BEHAVIOUR, SPRINGY WAS RECOIL, DENSE WAS ANCHOR. Which exposes what was wrong with the old vocabulary: BELLA’S OLD LABEL, SHRINE-RECOIL, WAS CARRYING TWO AXES IN ONE HYPHENATED TOKEN — Shrine for handfeel, Recoil for kinetic. The new field separates them.

AND THE MAPPING IS FOR ASS HANDFEEL ONLY. The retired labels were also used on HIPS — Quinn’s 44-inch SHRINE-ANCHOR hips, Arianna’s 46-inch IDOL-ANCHOR hips. Run those through the handfeel table and Quinn comes out PLIANT AND DENSE AT ONCE, which is incoherent. HIP LABELS DO NOT TRANSLATE THROUGH THIS TABLE. IDOL has no handfeel mapping at all; see q-idol-handfeel.

SUPERSEDED BY PILLAR THREE AND RETIRED, BY VIRAENA’S RULING. Read nereid-pillar-three for current law on every field above. THIS RECORD IS KEPT FOR THE TWO THINGS PILLAR THREE DOES NOT CARRY: THE SHRINE-TO-HANDFEEL MAPPING, which is the only bridge from the retired v7 labels still sitting on live records, AND BELLA’S AUTHORED SENTENCE, which is the household’s and not the Clinic’s. Everything else here is history.

SCALE: Tight · Natural · Grab-Ready · PAWG. Most of Ghost Haven is Grab-Ready
CHEEK PLUMP: Natural +0" · Subtle +1" · Pronounced +2" · Obscene +3"
NATURAL = UNMODIFIED, on every axis. It is the zero point, not a tier
SENTENCE: {Handfeel} {Shape} Butt {Scale} with {Plump} Cheek Plump and {Kinetic}
Ass and Butt are interchangeable in the sentence
