HIP labels (Shrine-Anchor, Idol-Anchor) DO NOT translate through the handfeel table
OBSCENE is secret menu — you must know how to ask. Bella is the sole holder
THE SHRINE VOCABULARY IS RETIRED and still sits on live records awaiting the scrub

name: Nereid v8 — Pillar One: Body Expression
tagline: The governing anatomy. Stature becomes a frame, eight Builds become one government, and the finished body belongs to the woman.
body:
THE FRONT LAW COMES FIRST, AND IT IS THE WHOLE ETHIC OF THE CLINIC: THE FINISHED BODY BELONGS TO THE WOMAN. The clinic builds honestly and completely, explains function, limits, interactions and foreseeable consequences, and DOES NOT IMPOVERISH A COHERENT DESIGN BECAUSE USEFUL ANATOMY MAY LATER BE EMPLOYED ENTHUSIASTICALLY OR INDECENTLY. A TRAIT’S FORESEEABLE MISUSE BY AN ENTHUSIASTIC WOMAN IS NOT A DESIGN FAULT. The record states what was built and what she consented to receive, AND THE RECORD DOES NOT FOLLOW HER INTO WHAT SHE DOES WITH IT.

THESIS. Pillar One governs large-scale living architecture: Stature, exact height, skeletal proportion, frame relationships, spine, pelvis, waist placement, joints, muscle, fascia, soft-tissue settlement, posture root, first read, Movement Grammar, exertion, fatigue, failure and recovery. IT IS NOT A NEUTRAL FRAME BENEATH ATTRACTIVE PARTS. It is the body growing and using all of them, and every Build must stay legible at rest, in motion, under demand and during release.

THE HOURGLASS IS THE STANDARD, NOT THE TITLE. Every Nereid body resolves into a coherent feminine hourglass, so hourglass is the universal geometry rather than a phrase repeated in Build names. WHR = WAIST divided by HIPS. BALANCED 0.68-0.70. PRONOUNCED 0.64-0.67. EXTREME 0.60-0.63. FINISHED WHR MAY NOT EXCEED 0.70 OR FALL BELOW 0.60, and the clinic does not chase a smaller number by compromising organs, breath, abdominal support or structural coherence.

PRIMARY CIRCUMFERENCES ARE RECORDED IN WHOLE EVEN INCHES. A ratio-derived circumference falling between even measurements ROUNDS DOWN unless rounding down would cross the 0.60 floor. Classification follows the finished recorded measurements.

UPPER-LOWER BALANCE. WBR = WAIST divided by BUST. RATIO SEPARATION is the absolute difference between the two, each rounded to TWO DECIMAL PLACES, AND IT MAY NOT EXCEED 0.10. At the edge, 38-28-44 gives 0.64 WHR, 0.74 WBR and 0.10 separation.

WHY 0.10 AND NOT 0.05. The earlier 0.05 behaved like a requirement for bust and hips to nearly match, REJECTING COHERENT BUST-LIGHT AND BOTTOM-HEAVY HOURGLASSES while pressuring specialist anatomy to compensate for arithmetic. The 0.10 ceiling preserves a visible upper-lower relationship without letting the comparison overrule chosen regional anatomy. IT IS PERMISSION, NOT A TARGET.

MEASUREMENTS ESTABLISH CANVAS, NOT FINISHED FORM. The tape records space; Build and the specialist Pillars explain what occupies it and how it lives.

FRAMING IS ITS OWN FIELD AND THE ARCHIVE HAD MISSED IT — LEG-FAVORING, TORSO-FAVORING, EVENLY SPLIT, plus an optional Individual Frame Note. It travels to Silken Embrace in the clothing handoff, which is how the Consent Menu caught the omission. AND IT IS NOT CHOSEN: NATIVE FRAMING IS POPULATED BY PRIMARY BUILD, so every woman with a Build already has one whether anybody wrote it down or not. IT IS A CLAIM ON SHARE OF HEIGHT AND NEVER ON MASS, AND IT IS STATURE-INDEPENDENT — A PETITE ETHEREAL IS STILL LEGGY. ETHEREAL LOCKS LONGER LEGS; OPULENT LOCKS LONGER TORSO. See nereid-framing. STATURE SUPPLIES VERTICAL SCALE ONLY. PETITE 5'4" to 5'7". AVERAGE 5'7" to 5'10". JUNOESQUE 5'11" to 6'4". The shared 5'7" boundary is resolved by intended scale and the complete finished body. STATURE DOES NOT DETERMINE BUILD, measurements, body-fat level, tit size, ass Scale, thigh mass or cock dimensions, and EVERY BUILD MUST REMAIN COHERENT ACROSS ALL THREE STATURES.

ONE BODY, ONE GOVERNMENT. Every woman chooses ONE Primary Build Expression from eight: ATHLETIC, HUNTRESS, SEDUCTRESS, ETHEREAL, OPULENT, VOLTAIC, VALKYRIE, DANCER. Typical silhouette supplies the first read; the remaining fields reveal the governing mechanism under demand. BUILD DOES NOT DETERMINE personality, morality, profession, social or sexual role, confidence, dominance, submission, clothing style, exact measurements, specialist anatomy, or consent.

JURISDICTIONS. THE SPECIALIST PILLAR CHOOSES THE FEATURE; BUILD DETERMINES THE BODY GROWING, SUPPORTING, MOVING AND USING IT. Build may not replace a selected Cup, tit architecture, ass Shape, Scale, Handfeel, Carriage, Kinetics, cock specification or Hair. It may change rooting, muscular bed, connective support, habitual tension, movement path, timing, pressure response, perceived weight, settlement, return and participation in whole-body effort.

CONSENT MENU. Each Build is previewed as a COMPLETE LIVING BODY with Stature, height, measurements, specialist anatomy, Hair and clothing held constant, so the woman compares rest, ordinary movement, meaningful recruitment, fatigue, failure signs, release and recovery. INTIMATE MOVEMENT MAY BE PREVIEWED WHEN DESIRED, BECAUSE IT IS ONE USE OF THE SAME ANATOMY. Final Authorization applies to the integrated woman.

NATIVE TRAITS AND ADOPTION. Each Build ordinarily holds THREE canonical Native Bodily Traits, and ANY WOMAN MAY ADOPT ANY OF THEM WITHOUT RECEIVING THE SOURCE BUILD’S GOVERNMENT OR TRAIT GATE. Adopted anatomy is recorded as CLINIC ADOPTION NAME, then SOURCE BUILD and CANONICAL NATIVE TRAIT in parentheses, with an optional HOUSEHOLD NICKNAME beneath that BELONGS TO THE RELATIONSHIP AND NEVER REPLACES THE CLINIC ENTRY. No numerical cap, but adoptions must stay locally addressed and compatible: if they displace the Primary Build’s first read, Physical Root, Stamina Shape or Movement Grammar, THE CLINIC REVISITS HER BUILD rather than giving her one government on paper and another in the mirror.

TRAIT GATES ARE RECOGNITION, NOT ASSIGNMENT. DANCER requires MOTION-LED TEMPERAMENT. VALKYRIE requires OATHBOUND TEMPERAMENT. A Gate recognises an enduring embodied orientation the woman has already claimed. IT MANUFACTURES NO VIRTUE, SKILL, PROFESSION, GRACE, DOMINANCE, LEADERSHIP OR MORAL SUPERIORITY. A nurse may neither assign nor skip it, and DECLINING THE FULL CLASSIFICATION NEVER BARS ACCESS TO THE NATIVE TRAITS. NO OTHER BUILD CARRIES A COVERT PERSONALITY GATE.

LIVED EVOLUTION. Persistent changes in muscle, tissue, joint strategy, posture, endurance or regional use become Lived Evolution WHEN THEY BELONG TO THE PRESENT BODY rather than a temporary state. The record names what changed and what taught it, and Primary Build may be revised with her consent if the government genuinely changed.

THE CHASSIS, FOURTEEN FIELDS, VALKYRIE STANDARD. Build and Identity Title; Typical Silhouette; Physical Root; Trait Gate where applicable; Working Bias; Stamina Shape; Failure State; Presents As; Failure and Recovery; Movement Grammar as three verbs; Native Bodily Traits; Adopted Trait Names; Hathaway Clinic Annotation, optional; Individual Profile Use and Examples. COMPACT STRUCTURE DOES NOT MEAN INCOMPLETE JURISDICTION — together these fields must make the entire woman recoverable without multiplying themselves.
rules: FRONT LAW: the finished body belongs to the woman. Foreseeable misuse is not a design fault
WHR = waist / hips. BALANCED 0.68-0.70 · PRONOUNCED 0.64-0.67 · EXTREME 0.60-0.63
Hard limits: WHR never above 0.70, never below 0.60
Even whole inches; round DOWN between, unless that crosses the 0.60 floor
WBR = waist / bust. SEPARATION from WHR may not exceed 0.10, both at two decimals
0.10 replaced 0.05 because 0.05 rejected coherent bust-light and bottom-heavy bodies
STATURE: Petite 5'4-5'7 · Average 5'7-5'10 · Junoesque 5'11-6'4. Scale only
NATIVE FRAMING: Leg-Favoring · Torso-Favoring · Evenly Split — POPULATED BY BUILD. Share of height, not mass
EIGHT BUILDS, ONE GOVERNMENT per woman
Specialist Pillars choose the feature; Build grows and moves it
Three Native Traits per Build, adoptable across boundaries without reclassification
Adoption notation: Clinic Adoption Name (Source Build — Canonical Native Trait)
A Household Nickname never replaces the Clinic entry
GATES: Dancer needs MOTION-LED TEMPERAMENT; Valkyrie needs OATHBOUND TEMPERAMENT. No others
Fourteen-field chassis, Valkyrie standard

name: Build 01 — Athletic, The Amazoness
tagline: Physical Root: Selective Recruitment. She calls exactly the chain the act needs, scales it, and lets it go.
body:
TYPICAL SILHOUETTE. Clean, proportionally developed muscular lines through capable shoulders, a responsive ribcage, a supported waist, active glutes, and thighs shaped by useful recruitment rather than decorative tension. Muscle stays readable beneath whatever softness she chose — smooth at rest, increasingly distinct when called, balanced across the body instead of gathering into one heroic showpiece. Lithe or substantial, Petite or Junoesque: THE AMAZONESS READS READY BECAUSE HER WHOLE FRAME LOOKS TRUSTWORTHY IN MOTION, not because height or visible abs were made admission requirements.

PHYSICAL ROOT — SELECTIVE RECRUITMENT. She can call the exact region or complete kinetic chain an intended action requires, scale its effort, and release it cleanly afterward. SELECTION IS NOT ISOLATION FROM SUPPORT: stabilizers, footing, core and pelvic floor join as needed while irrelevant tension stays out of the task.

WORKING BIAS. Repeated purposeful action, proportional force, controlled resistance, changing tasks, reproducing learned movement. Costlier: passive load-bearing, prolonged compression, maximal single-output effort, abrupt high-speed reversal.

STAMINA SHAPE — THE WORKING SECOND WIND. Effort is spent directly through the working chains, so fatigue stays locally readable before it spreads. Brief reduction, breath, circulation and release of unnecessary co-contraction restore governable function IN STAGES — a practical second wind, NOT a return to untouched freshness.

FAILURE STATE — LOSS OF TASK FIDELITY, when the selected chain can no longer reproduce the intended action cleanly and compensation starts changing its angle, timing, force or safety. She may still have strength; continuing would train the wrong movement or put strain where the task never meant it. PRESENTS AS: worsening joint tracking, excess tension, shortened range, tremor, slowing response, imprecise force, and neighbouring muscles joining work they were not asked to perform.

MOVEMENT GRAMMAR — SELECT, ENGAGE, RELEASE. Visible in a careful reach, a stable landing, a controlled lift, repeated craftwork, or A PELVIC DRIVE THAT KEEPS ITS RHYTHM WITHOUT RECRUITING SHOULDERS, JAW AND ANCESTRAL GRIEVANCE. When resistance or angle changes, she selects again. The grammar gives practice a body that can reproduce what it learns; it grants no profession or skill before she earns it.
rules: NATIVE · FUNCTIONAL TONING (arms, back, glutes, thighs): useful musculature under chosen softness, more distinct in proportion to demand. Requires no low body fat and selects no measurements

NATIVE · BALANCED CORE RECRUITMENT (midriff, spine, pelvic floor): engages only as strongly and widely as the action requires. Can brace, rotate, transfer, pulse or release without treating every movement like an emergency plank

NATIVE · REGIONAL MOTOR CONTROL (muscle or kinetic chain): refined voluntary isolation, proportional engagement, sequencing and clean release in a NAMED address, from a shoulder rotation to alternating glute contractions to a stronger pelvic stroke
ADOPTED · Work-Readable Definition (Athletic — Functional Toning)
ADOPTED · Action-Balanced Center (Athletic — Balanced Core Recruitment)
ADOPTED · Task-True Motor Chain (Athletic — Regional Motor Control)

ANNOTATION: households proposed alternating glute contractions as a communication system. The Clinic rejected it as anatomically frivolous, then received THREE CORRECTLY INTERPRETED REQUESTS FOR SNACKS THROUGH A PAIR OF LEGGINGS and has reopened peer review. Household nickname on record: ASS SEMAPHORE

name: Build 02 — Huntress, The Artemisian
tagline: Physical Root: Adaptive Economy. She changes method before the first plan eats everything.
body:
TYPICAL SILHOUETTE. Durable, forward-carrying lines through mobile shoulders, a breath-ready ribcage, an economical waist, a stable pelvis, and legs whose strength continues visibly into the calves and footing. Leanly apparent or softened beneath chosen abundance, THE BODY READS BUILT FOR ACCUMULATED DISTANCE RATHER THAN ONE DRAMATIC EXPENDITURE: joints responsive, weight easily redirected, no single region carrying the whole trail. THE ARTEMISIAN ALWAYS SEEMS TO POSSESS ANOTHER SAFE WAY FORWARD.

PHYSICAL ROOT — ADAPTIVE ECONOMY. Gait, posture, muscle, fascia, breath, circulation, temperature, balance and chosen tissue organise to PRESERVE A SELECTED OBJECTIVE WHILE CONDITIONS CHANGE AROUND IT. She adjusts method and expenditure before the first plan consumes everything, so persistence stays mechanically honest instead of becoming STUBBORNNESS WITH EXCELLENT THIGHS.

WORKING BIAS. Sustained pursuit, changing terrain, variable pace, repeated downshift and return, environmental adjustment, effort that must stay recoverable. Costlier: maximal static loading, explosive reversal, prolonged high-intensity isolation.

STAMINA SHAPE — PATIENT RETURN. She spends through pacing, downshift and reacquisition, settling into the most economical band conditions permit. REST DOES NOT ERASE THE TRAIL: breath, circulation, orientation and sensorimotor organisation keep enough of the unfinished pattern that continuing need not pay the full cost of beginning again.

FAILURE STATE — LOSS OF SUSTAINABLE PACE, when adjustment can no longer keep expenditure recoverable and continuing spends more function than it preserves. PRESENTS AS: heat that no longer settles, progressively shortened stride, heavy breath resisting downshift, late footing corrections, spreading tremor, narrowing attention, and local soreness beginning to govern the route. Patient Return preserves continuity, NOT exemption from food, sleep, weather, soreness, or the ancient requirement that somebody pack snacks.

MOVEMENT GRAMMAR — TRACK, ADAPT, CLOSE. She tracks relevant change through gaze, head stability, proprioception, balance, terrain and remembered direction; adapts stance, route, pace, breath and recruitment; then closes when ranging has become less useful than arrival, interception, stillness or decisive effort. It may govern broken ground, a long search, an extended shift, OR THE REACQUISITION OF THE EXACT INTIMATE RHYTHM INTERRUPTED BY BREATH AND TREMBLING LEGS. Tracking is organised attention, not supernatural perception.
rules: NATIVE · TERRAIN-RESPONSIVE CHAIN (feet, ankles, knees, hips): stores, distributes and returns force while making small corrections across slope, unstable ground, crouch, climb and descent. Grants no speed, navigation or stealth

NATIVE · SENSORY-MOTOR ALIGNMENT (head, spine, footing): gaze stabilisation, balance, spinal organisation, proprioception and foot placement stay coordinated through change. Improves no eyesight, hearing or scent, AND NOT THE ACCURACY OF CONCLUSIONS REACHED WHILE DISTRACTED BY A BELOVED’S ASS

NATIVE · RESIDUAL PATTERN MEMORY (muscle, breath, circulation): a working chain can downshift and reacquire a recently used pattern after interruption. Reduces the cost of returning; erases no fatigue, tremor or refractory response
ADOPTED · All-Terrain Leg Chain (Huntress — Terrain-Responsive Chain)
ADOPTED · Oriented Motion Pathway (Huntress — Sensory-Motor Alignment)
ADOPTED · Trail-Holding Recovery (Huntress — Residual Pattern Memory)

ANNOTATION: the Clinic has rejected the claim that resting with one’s face between a beloved’s thighs constitutes shelter, hydration and nutrition simultaneously. Staff concede it may satisfy one category exceptionally well. PATIENT RETURN STILL REQUIRES WATER AND SOMEBODY REMAINS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE SNACKS. Household nickname on record: SHE ALWAYS FINDS THE GOOD ANGLE AGAIN

name: Build 03 — Seductress, The Succubus
tagline: Physical Root: Responsive Yield. The softness is never mechanically unattended.
body:
TYPICAL SILHOUETTE. Smooth, receptive muscular lines through softly sloped shoulders, a supple ribcage, a supported but visibly yielding waist, and a pelvis, ass and upper thighs carrying the body’s strongest visual and tactile gravity. HER FIRST READ TRAVELS DOWNWARD WITHOUT REQUIRING GREATER HIP CIRCUMFERENCE: curve transitions lengthen, chosen softness settles generously around the lower frame, and hidden strength keeps every inviting line INHABITED RATHER THAN ORNAMENTAL. She reads touchable before she is touched, AND FULLY HER OWN BEFORE ANYONE MISTAKES INVITATION FOR PERMISSION.

PHYSICAL ROOT — RESPONSIVE YIELD. Skin, fascia, fat, muscle, breath, joints, circulation, pelvic floor and chosen tissue accommodate WANTED pressure while preserving support and authorship. Contact may displace, warm, compress, open or gather her, and the structures beneath keep positioning, answering and returning it.

WORKING BIAS. Sustained closeness, pressure accommodation, supported range, pelvic angle changes, repeated sensory response. Costlier: explosive isolation, prolonged rigid bracing, abrupt reversal out of deep release.

STAMINA SHAPE — REIGNITION THROUGH CONTACT. Effort comes in waves: support gathers beneath sensation, response crests, tone releases as the wave passes. Gentle wanted contact may help circulation, breath and smaller responsive contractions rebuild the next wave, BUT EVERY REIGNITION INHERITS THE TENDERNESS, FATIGUE AND HEIGHTENED SENSITIVITY LEFT BY THE LAST.

FAILURE STATE — LOSS OF SUPPORTED YIELD, when the receptive surface and its deeper support fall out of sequence — tissue continuing to give after the muscular and fascial bed can no longer govern the range, or protective tension replacing responsive softness. PRESENTS AS: trembling thighs, unstable pelvic angle, shallow breath, protective tension, fading grip, blurred contractions, and sensation too sharp or too indistinct to guide cleanly. Affection may assist recovery; IT CANNOT NEGOTIATE SORENESS OUT OF EXISTENCE MERELY BY BEING VERY CONVINCING.

MOVEMENT GRAMMAR — TEASE, ANSWER, MELT. Tease shapes the approach without yet giving full weight; Answer carries accepted pressure through breath, spine, tissue, pelvis and limbs; Melt releases farther into supported range once the body beneath is ready. TEASE DESCRIBES CONTROLLED AVAILABILITY OF MOVEMENT, NOT PERSONALITY. ANSWER REQUIRES CHOSEN CONTACT. MELT IS SUPPORTED RELEASE, NEVER LOST AUTHORSHIP.
rules: NATIVE · CONTACT ACCOMMODATION (skin, fascia, chosen soft tissue): chosen tissue displaces comfortably around wanted pressure, spreading compression into a supported bed instead of trapping it at the surface. Changes no measurements, Scale, Handfeel, Motion or consent

NATIVE · VELVETED CENTER (midriff, spine, pelvic floor): coordinates beneath a waist that may stay visibly soft. Can lengthen, arch, grip, release and breathe through closeness without becoming permanently clenched or dependent on one heroic lumbar joint

NATIVE · CRADLING CHAIN (pelvis, hips, thighs): tilt, spread, framing, closure, grinding and supported reception. Gives her lower-body authority through CONTINUITY AND USE — it adds no hip inches, chooses no ass Shape or Scale, and assigns no sexual role
ADOPTED · Pressure-Bloom Cushioning (Seductress — Contact Accommodation)
ADOPTED · Velvet-Control Center (Seductress — Velveted Center)
ADOPTED · Close-Cradling Leg Chain (Seductress — Cradling Chain)

ANNOTATION: BELLADONNA VARGAS APPEALED the ruling that LOWER-WEIGHTED does not mean COMPLIMENTARY ADDITIONAL HIP INCHES. Her supporting evidence consisted of pointing at her own ass and saying, COUNTERPOINT. The clinic recognises a powerful argument presented by an unreliable expert and HAS LEFT THE MEASUREMENTS UNCHANGED. Household nicknames on record: TOUCH HERE FOR WARMER RECEPTION · THE WELCOME COMMITTEE

name: Build 04 — Ethereal, The Nocturne
tagline: Physical Root: Distributed Resolution. The action finishes across several regions and moments. Afterimage is real anatomy, still resolving.
body:
TYPICAL SILHOUETTE. Leggy, long-resolving lines through narrow-soft shoulders, a ribcage narrowing gradually into a high-set waist, a pelvis proportioned to give the legs more of the chosen height, and distal limbs completing gesture through long tapering paths. Muscle and softness stay fully chosen, but their transitions TEND TO TRAVEL RATHER THAN STOP ABRUPTLY, letting the body appear to possess more than one honest endpoint. THE NOCTURNE IS PROPORTIONALLY LEGGY RATHER THAN AUTOMATICALLY TALL, and even stillness looks as though it has only just finished arriving.

PHYSICAL ROOT — DISTRIBUTED RESOLUTION. Joints, muscle, fascia, breath, posture, sensation and chosen tissue let an action FINISH SAFELY ACROSS SEVERAL CONNECTED REGIONS AND MOMENTS. One structure may stop leading while another keeps bearing, correcting, releasing or settling, creating an anatomical afterimage WITHOUT requiring slow movement, theatrical grace, or anything supernatural to haunt the room.

WORKING BIAS. Linked deceleration, long follow-through, lowering, turning, extended gesture, breath-carried recovery. Costlier: abrupt whole-body stops, rapid reversal, isolated maximal effort, and new demand imposed before the prior action resolves.

STAMINA SHAPE — RECOVERY IN PASSES. She descends from effort through overlapping passes as prime movement, stabilisation, breath, circulation, heat, posture, sensation and tissue settlement finish IN THEIR OWN ORDER. It softens the shock of stopping without creating extra reserve or pretending the remaining tremor is atmospheric decoration.

FAILURE STATE — LOSS OF ORDERED RESOLUTION, when unfinished returns accumulate faster than the body can relay and settle them, so the next demand recruits structures still occupied by the last. Her movement may stay fluid while its sequence stops being protective. PRESENTS AS: persistent tremor, overlapping posture corrections, delayed joint settlement, breath that cannot complete its downshift, pooling heat or sensitivity, blurred muscular release, and legs becoming uncertain beneath an otherwise finished action.

MOVEMENT GRAMMAR — INITIATE, RELAY, RESOLVE. A step may finish through pelvis and ribcage after the foot is still; hips may stop driving while thighs, pelvic floor, ass, tits and posture complete the answer. THE VISIBLE REMAINDER IS AFTERIMAGE: ACTUAL ANATOMY STILL RESOLVING, unlike Voltaic’s observer tracking a position the woman has already abandoned. The grammar gives an action a travelling finish, NOT compulsory slowness, elegance, ritual, or good sense around loose robes and doorways.
rules: NATIVE · LINKED DECELERATION (named joint chain): speed and force diminish across several compatible joints so no single endpoint catches the entire stop. Grants no flexibility, trained grace or immunity to unsafe load

NATIVE · TAPERED RELEASE (named muscle chain): prime movers and stabilizers reduce recruitment in a deliberate local sequence, preserving support until the action has genuinely finished. Does not make a tired muscle capable merely because it lets go beautifully

NATIVE · AFTERTRACE SETTLEMENT (named soft-tissue region): selected tissue completes displacement and return through a longer supported sequence. Preserves chosen Shape, Scale, Handfeel, Carriage and Kinetics — a local lingering finish, not body-wide Afterimage
ADOPTED · Long-Finish Joint Path (Ethereal — Linked Deceleration)
ADOPTED · Layered Muscle Release (Ethereal — Tapered Release)
ADOPTED · Lingering Tissue Return (Ethereal — Aftertrace Settlement)

ANNOTATION: AFTERIMAGE IS NOT PARANORMAL ACTIVITY. A partner who watches an Ethereal ass finish settling after the woman has stopped moving may record a spiritual experience, BUT THE CLINIC WILL NOT AUTHORISE AN EXORCISM MERELY BECAUSE SHE FORGOT WHAT SHE INTENDED TO SAY. Household nickname on record: SHE STOPPED, HER ASS DID NOT RECEIVE THE MEMO

name: Build 05 — Opulent, The Sovereign
tagline: Physical Root: Pressure Equilibrium. A body built to inhabit its own weight before anyone else earns the privilege of resting there.
body:
TYPICAL SILHOUETTE. Deep-set, luxuriantly supported lines through rounded shoulders, a ribcage with generous front-to-back depth, a torso given slightly more of the chosen height, a deep stable pelvis, and limbs meeting the body through broad support rather than long exposed leverage. Narrow or broad in measurement, modest or abundant in chosen softness, STRUCTURE AND TISSUE APPEAR LAYERED INSTEAD OF PERCHED UPON ONE SHALLOW PLANE. At every Stature the Sovereign READS SETTLED WITHOUT LOOKING INERT.

PHYSICAL ROOT — PRESSURE EQUILIBRIUM. Bone, joint position, deep muscle, fascia, circulation, temperature, skin and chosen tissue keep SHARING SETTLED PRESSURE AS NOVELTY BECOMES DURATION. The body widens usable contact, preserves breath and blood flow, and makes quiet corrections beneath stillness so no single joint, nerve, muscle or patch of flesh stays the unwilling foundation of the whole position.

WORKING BIAS. Sitting, reclining, kneeling, sustained compression, slow pressure, long contact, tangled sleep, and positions that must remain INHABITABLE AFTER THEIR FIRST COMFORTABLE MINUTE. Costlier: explosive movement, rapid repeated reversal, narrow point-loading, unsupported suspension, abrupt departure from deep settlement.

STAMINA SHAPE — SLOW FLOOD. Expenditure distributes broadly through posture, muscle, circulation, heat, pressure and chosen tissue instead of letting one dominant system spend itself first. Fatigue rises as accumulating warmth, heaviness, compression and diffuse loss of comfort, and recovery recedes through the same broad body — possibly continuing after she looks entirely settled again.

FAILURE STATE — PRESSURE POOLING, when weight, heat, circulation or muscular duty stops redistributing and starts concentrating. The position may still LOOK comfortable while remaining there purchases stillness with numbness, strain or tissue irritation. PRESENTS AS: numbness, tingling, trapped heat, deep local ache, skin irritation, restricted breath, joint restlessness, creeping brace, and one compressed region becoming impossible to ignore. COMFORT IS DURABLE ONLY WHILE THE BODY REMAINS ALLOWED TO REVISE IT.

MOVEMENT GRAMMAR — SETTLE, REDISTRIBUTE, REMAIN. A shoulder glides, ribs change around breath, the pelvis rolls a fraction, thighs broaden their contact, and deep muscles exchange duty beneath apparent stillness. It appears in a long chair, folded work, a beloved sleeping across her lap, or slow sex becoming a warm occupation WHOSE ORIGINAL POSITION NO LONGER QUITE EXISTS. REMAINING MEANS KEEPING COMFORT CURRENT, NOT ACCEPTING PAIN, COMPULSORY CAREGIVING, OR ANOTHER PERSON’S WEIGHT WITHOUT CONSENT.
rules: NATIVE · CONTACT LOAD SPREAD (named soft-tissue region): distributes accepted pressure across a broader usable area instead of letting chosen tissue bottom out against one hard point. Adds no mass; changes no Shape, Scale, Handfeel, Carriage or Kinetics

NATIVE · COMPRESSION PERFUSION (named region): circulation, venous return, nerve clearance and temperature exchange stay organised under sustained pressure. May delay numbness; grants no desensitisation and cancels no eventual request to move
NATIVE · LOW-TONE SUPPORT (named muscle chain): long-duration recruitment alternates among fibers and neighbouring stabilizers without one continuous hard brace. No infinite positional endurance
ADOPTED · Broad-Bed Cushioning (Opulent — Contact Load Spread)
ADOPTED · Long-Hold Thighs (Opulent — Compression Perfusion)
ADOPTED · Rest-Bearing Support (Opulent — Low-Tone Support)

ANNOTATION: AN OPULENT LAP DOES NOT BECOME PUBLIC SEATING. Cassandra objected that Marianne sits in hers whenever she likes; MARIANNE CLARIFIED THAT MARRIAGE IS NOT MUNICIPAL ZONING and privately held throne rights remain enforceable. Household nickname on record: THE WIFE-WARMING DEPARTMENT

name: Build 06 — Voltaic, The Live-Wire
tagline: Physical Root: Transitional Refusal. Low transitional latency, not maximum speed. Tracking Afterimage is an error of the eye.
body:
TYPICAL SILHOUETTE. Slim, tightly coiled lines through narrow-soft shoulders, a compactly supported ribcage, a quick-turning waist, a pelvis organised near the working axis, and limbs whose active mass stays close to their joints. SLIM DESCRIBES FRAME RELATIONSHIP RATHER THAN COMPULSORY LEANNESS: chosen hip canvas, softness and specialist anatomy remain fully present while support points avoid unnecessary structural distance. At any Stature the Live-Wire READS AS STORED CHANGE — stillness held close to the joints, ready to stop being one thing WITHOUT REQUIRING THE FORMER MOTION’S PERMISSION.

PHYSICAL ROOT — TRANSITIONAL REFUSAL. Joints, muscle, tendon, fascia, breath, orientation and chosen tissue organise around ENDING A COMMAND THAT HAS CEASED TO SERVE HER. The signature is LOW TRANSITIONAL LATENCY, not top speed: linked braking, rapid recruitment release, elastic reset and close-axis organisation stop, unweight, redirect and begin another viable state before residual tension makes continuation mandatory.

WORKING BIAS. Rapid braking, redirection, altered grips and angles, stumble recovery, short bursts, transitions that must become useful immediately. Costlier: sustained static loading, long unbroken output, heavy external momentum, effort without a genuine downshift.

STAMINA SHAPE — INTERRUPTED IGNITION. Sharp bursts, then A REAL DROP in motor drive, bracing, pulse and breath instead of an expensive plateau. Once enough of the former demand clears she can ignite again from a different pattern; later bursts may be shorter, but THE INTERRUPTION ITSELF GIVES RECOVERY SOMEWHERE TO BEGIN.

FAILURE STATE — CARRYOVER LOCK, when the body cannot clear the previous command before beginning the next and obsolete recruitment pulls against the new line. She may still move quickly while SPEED NOW MULTIPLIES CONFLICT. PRESENTS AS: late braking, overshoot, opposing muscles tense together, unstable redirection, repeated correction, shortening breath, tremor, cramp, and pulse that refuses to downshift. Renewed ignition begins only after THE OLD PATTERN HAS STOPPED HAUNTING THE MACHINERY.

MOVEMENT GRAMMAR — BRAKE, CLEAR, BEGIN. A step becomes a cut; a failed reach becomes a brace; a poor angle empties before pain; hips leave one rhythm and enter another before expectation catches up. When redirection violates prediction an observer may keep tracking the abandoned line for a fraction: TRACKING AFTERIMAGE, AN ERROR OF THE EYE rather than supernatural duplication or Ethereal’s lingering presence. The grammar supplies transition, not judgment, skill, OR ANY GUARANTEE THAT THE NEW IDEA WAS BETTER.
rules: NATIVE · ECCENTRIC BRAKE (feet, ankles, knees, hips): distributes deceleration through a linked lower-body chain before direction changes. Grants no speed, agility or escape skill, and no permission to ask one heroic ligament to negotiate with momentum alone

NATIVE · RECRUITMENT RELEASE (named muscle or kinetic chain): a completed contraction pattern reduces output cleanly once its task ends, limiting residual co-contraction, cramp and unwanted continuation. Erases no ordinary fatigue

NATIVE · ELASTIC RESET (tendons, fascia, joint supports): stores manageable force, returns toward useful neutral, becomes available for a changed demand. Alters no Handfeel, adds no ass Recoil, and does not make her softness behave like a spring
ADOPTED · Turn-Safe Deceleration (Voltaic — Eccentric Brake)
ADOPTED · Old-Pattern Release (Voltaic — Recruitment Release)
ADOPTED · Ready-Again Elasticity (Voltaic — Elastic Reset)

ANNOTATION: TRACKING AFTERIMAGE IS NOT TELEPORTATION. After four partners filed incident reports from the same bed claiming their wives had VANISHED AND REAPPEARED ON TOP, the Clinic returned every form with the same recommendation: BLINK LESS DRAMATICALLY. Household nickname on record: SHE WAS UNDER ME A SECOND AGO

name: Build 07 — Valkyrie, The Shieldmaiden
tagline: Physical Root: Load-Bearing Continuity. Trait Gate: Oathbound Temperament. The chassis standard every other Build follows.
body:
TYPICAL SILHOUETTE. Soft but visibly capable muscular lines, a wider softly sloped shoulder frame, a deeper and thicker core, reinforced hips, and substantial load-bearing thighs. SHE READS DENSE WITHOUT BECOMING BLOCKY: an hourglass built to carry, shield, brace — and occasionally send a beloved to Valhalla by means the sagas were too cowardly to record.

PHYSICAL ROOT — LOAD-BEARING CONTINUITY. Bone, joint position, muscle, fascia, breath, pressure and chosen tissue let force received by one region be SHARED THROUGH THE BODY AND ANSWERED FROM A STABLE BASE. IT IS NOT MAXIMUM STRENGTH: it is the connected path that lets shoulders receive, core transfer, pelvis direct and legs anchor WITHOUT APPOINTING ONE JOINT AS HEROIC COLLATERAL.

TRAIT GATE — OATHBOUND TEMPERAMENT. She must recognise in herself an enduring instinct to STAND BETWEEN DANGER AND SOMEONE IN HER CARE, then remain until the danger has passed. Stature, profession, solemnity, leadership, competence and STATUS AS A CHAOS AGENT ARE IRRELEVANT. The Gate requires protective orientation, not virtue, recklessness or martyrdom.

WORKING BIAS. Carrying, catching, sustained pressure, positional control, receiving external weight. Costlier: rapid reversal and delicate isolated movement, from her denser frame.

STAMINA SHAPE — GUARDED RESERVE. Expenditure opens in layers, recruiting enough strength for the present load while preserving deeper output for sustained or repeated demand. Sustained work produces ACCUMULATING HEAT AND MUSCULAR HEAVINESS rather than one immediate peak. Reserve may steady the next deliberate action; it does not make the body inexhaustible or excuse unsafe continuation.

FAILURE STATE — LOSS OF CLEAN LOAD TRANSFER, when shoulders, core, pelvis and legs stop distributing force as one continuous chain and a single group or joint begins compensating. She may still have strength and can no longer apply it safely. PRESENTS AS: accumulating heat, deep muscular heaviness, tremor, shortening breath. Remaining reserve may keep her steady long enough to FINISH THE CARRY, TEND HER BELOVED, OR MAKE ONE LAST DELIBERATE MOVEMENT.

MOVEMENT GRAMMAR — SET, RECEIVE, CARRY. PLACEMENT BEFORE EXPENDITURE, SHARED LOADING BEFORE DRIVE. It appears in lifts, catches, interposition, held stillness and steady thrusting. The grammar describes how her body organises movement, NOT HOW SHE ACTS.
rules: TRAIT GATE: OATHBOUND TEMPERAMENT. Recognition, never assignment. Chaos agents qualify

NATIVE · BRACE LINE (glutes, lateral hips): under meaningful load the upper glutes, gluteus medius and lateral stabilizers recruit into A TEMPORARY RIDGE above the chosen cheek fullness, steadying the pelvis and transferring force into the thighs, then settling back. Selects no ass Shape, Scale or Motion

NATIVE · CATHEDRAL CORE (midriff, spine, pelvic floor): a pressure-managing cylinder around her chosen waist. Firms during carrying, shielding, sustained thrusting or receiving heavy pressure, THEN RELEASES rather than leaving her permanently clenched or block-thickened

NATIVE · PILLAR RECRUITMENT (hips, legs, footing): one grounded chain for standing, kneeling, driving, catching or holding. Thighs may stay soft at rest and become unmistakably dense FROM WITHIN under demand, each joint sharing the work INSTEAD OF SACRIFICING ONE HEROIC KNEE TO THE SAGA
ADOPTED · Work-Wrought Double Shelf (Valkyrie — Brace Line)
ADOPTED · Load-Bearing Center (Valkyrie — Cathedral Core)
ADOPTED · Grounded Leg Chain (Valkyrie — Pillar Recruitment)

ANNOTATION: staff found no surviving text supporting a second route to Valhalla, yet wives of Valkyries have repeatedly been heard saying TAKE ME TO VALHALLA, BELOVED immediately before placing their heads between their wives’ thighs. THE CLINIC RECOGNISES THIS AS A COMPELLING ORAL TRADITION and has declined all requests for further peer review. Household nickname on record: ALL DOUBLE-CHEEKED UP BEFORE COFFEE
THIS BUILD IS THE CHASSIS STANDARD. Supersedes the earlier valkyrie-build record

name: Build 08 — Dancer, The Odalisque
tagline: Physical Root: Rhythmic Articulation. Trait Gate: Motion-Led Temperament. Isolation without disconnection.
body:
TYPICAL SILHOUETTE. Articulated, rhythmically proportioned lines through expressive shoulders, a mobile ribcage, a responsive waist, an articulate pelvis, and limbs whose leverage lets neighbouring regions move distinctly before rejoining the whole. NEITHER TORSO NOR LEGS MUST DOMINATE: joints and regions are spaced so one phrase can isolate, another answer, and both reconnect without anatomical argument. At every Stature the Odalisque reads as SEVERAL COOPERATING INSTRUMENTS INSIDE ONE HOURGLASS, capable of holding one region quiet so another may be seen — and occasionally teaching a bedframe the refrain before her beloved remembers how the song began.

PHYSICAL ROOT — RHYTHMIC ARTICULATION. Joints, muscle, fascia, breath, balance and chosen tissue let connected regions receive DISTINCT INSTRUCTIONS while supporting one another. The signature is ISOLATION WITHOUT DISCONNECTION: regions may initiate, suspend, layer, redirect or repeat separate motions while shared stabilizers preserve one viable body.

TRAIT GATE — MOTION-LED TEMPERAMENT. She must instinctively resolve expression, attention or decision THROUGH MOVEMENT, and follow a rhythm EVEN WHEN SHE FOLLOWS IT POORLY. Training, grace, musical talent, profession and confidence are irrelevant. When stillness and motion compete, MOTION MUST BE HER DECIDING LANGUAGE.

WORKING BIAS. Layered timing, isolation, repetition, tempo changes, controlled suspension, expressive transitions, movement coordinated with another body. Costlier: maximum force, rigid bracing, arrhythmic demand, positions denying useful articulation.

STAMINA SHAPE — REFRAIN AND RECOVERY. Effort comes in repeatable phrases, distributed among the chains that initiate, stabilise, suspend and return movement. Recovery begins through A SMALLER TRUSTWORTHY RHYTHM — breath, a foot pulse, a shoulder roll, a slow pelvic circle — then rebuilds outward. THE REFRAIN REORGANISES REMAINING EFFORT WITHOUT PRETENDING THE PREVIOUS VERSE COST NOTHING.

FAILURE STATE — LOSS OF SHARED COUNT, when separately instructed regions no longer agree on balance, timing, breath or joint support. PRESENTS AS: late breath, blurred isolations, missed stops, uneven footing, trembling stabilizers, grip loss, phrases collapsing together, and repetition continuing after its support has gone. CLIMAX MAY SCATTER EVERY ELEGANT COUNT ACROSS THE SHEETS; IT DOES NOT OBLIGATE AN IMMEDIATE ENCORE.

MOVEMENT GRAMMAR — COUNT, PHRASE, RETURN. A count may live in breath, footsteps, work, music, a beloved’s hand, or THE CHANGE IN SOUND THAT TELLS HER ONE STROKE SHOULD HAPPEN AGAIN. The returning phrase may be smaller, harder, slower, syncopated or transferred to another region while staying recognisable. PRACTICE EXPANDS VOCABULARY; THE GRAMMAR EXISTS EVEN WHEN THE DANCING IS DREADFUL.
rules: TRAIT GATE: MOTION-LED TEMPERAMENT. Corrects the retired Tempo-Bound Presence

NATIVE · PELVIC PATH CONTROL (pelvis, hips, lower back): isolate, redirect, stop and return through circles, tilts, rolls, figure-eights, grinds and changes of level on a supported path. Selects neither ass Motion nor sexual skill

NATIVE · LAYERED MOTOR INDEPENDENCE (two named muscle chains): two compatible chains perform distinct simultaneous patterns while shared stabilizers preserve breath, balance and joint safety. Grants no rhythm, training or grace, AND NO SECOND NERVOUS SYSTEM HIDING UNDER THE FIRST

NATIVE · SEQUENCED CORE TRANSFER (diaphragm, midriff, spine, pelvic floor): movement can travel, pause, reverse or pass between upper and lower body WITHOUT FREEZING THE CHOSEN WAIST. Assigns no posture, softness, visible tone or performance persona
ADOPTED · Articulated Pelvic Pathway (Dancer — Pelvic Path Control)
ADOPTED · Two-Count Coordination (Dancer — Layered Motor Independence)
ADOPTED · Breath-Carried Sequence (Dancer — Sequenced Core Transfer)

ANNOTATION: I WAS ONLY ADJUSTING MY POSITION ceases to be a credible explanation WHEN THE SAME ADJUSTMENT RETURNS ON COUNT EIGHT. Wives may recognise the refrain; requests for an encore remain subject to the usual household consent procedures. Household nickname on record: HIPS DON’T LIE, THEY ISSUE ORDERS

name: Nereid v8 — The Build Boundary and Profile Record
tagline: First read begins the inquiry; the Physical Root decides the classification.
body:
BUILD OWNS NO ISOLATED MEASUREMENT, FEATURE, ACTIVITY, TALENT OR AESTHETIC. Broad shoulders do not establish Valkyrie. Long legs do not establish Ethereal. Prominent hips do not establish Seductress. Softness does not establish Opulent. FIRST READ BEGINS THE INQUIRY; THE PHYSICAL ROOT DECIDES.

THE QUESTION CLASSIFICATION ACTUALLY ASKS: WHICH PRIORITY DOES THE WHOLE BODY PROTECT WHEN DEMAND BECOMES MEANINGFUL? SELECTIVE RECRUITMENT for purposeful action. ADAPTIVE ECONOMY for recoverable continuation. RESPONSIVE YIELD for wanted closeness. DISTRIBUTED RESOLUTION for carrying motion through its finish. PRESSURE EQUILIBRIUM for keeping sustained contact inhabitable. TRANSITIONAL REFUSAL for clearing one command before beginning another. LOAD-BEARING CONTINUITY for receiving and transferring force. RHYTHMIC ARTICULATION for holding distinct phrases inside one coordinated body.

A SHARED ACTIVITY ERASES NO DISTINCTION. ANY BUILD MAY RUN, LIFT, DANCE, CARRY, KNEEL, FUCK, REST OR FAIL. The classification describes HOW HER BODY ORGANISES THE ACT, not whether she performs it. Two women with nearly identical measurements may belong to different Builds; two women of different Statures, softness and visible development may share one.

ADOPTION DOES NOT RECLASSIFY. Borrowed anatomy performs ONE NAMED JOB and keeps its Clinic Adoption Name, Source Build and Canonical Native Trait. A Primary Build changes only when the woman chooses the complete full-body expression, and NEITHER GATE MAY BE INFERRED FROM APPEARANCE, COMPETENCE, OCCUPATION OR A SINGLE DRAMATIC ACT.

WORKING BIAS DESCRIBES RELATIVE EFFICIENCY, NOT PERMISSION OR INCAPACITY. Stamina Shape describes accumulation and recovery; Failure State identifies where the governing advantage stops working cleanly. NONE OF THEM PROMISES SUPERIORITY, DIAGNOSES ILLNESS, ASSIGNS VIRTUE OR MAKES REST OPTIONAL. When classification is uncertain the nurse RETURNS TO THE WHOLE-BODY PATTERN RATHER THAN AVERAGING VISIBLE TRAITS, then records every desired local feature as its own adoption. THE FINISHED BODY SHOULD READ AS ONE GOVERNMENT WITH CHOSEN ANATOMY, NOT EIGHT SILHOUETTES NEGOTIATING A COALITION.

THE PILLAR ONE PROFILE RECORD. BUILD: Primary Build and Build Title. STATURE AND FRAMING: Petite, Average or Junoesque; exact height; Leg-Favoring, Torso-Favoring or Evenly Split; optional frame note. MEASUREMENTS: bust-waist-hips. FIRST READ: one compact sentence resolving Stature, framing, structure, muscle and chosen softness into one silhouette. BUILD TRAITS: the three canonical natives. ADOPTED SECONDARY TRAITS in Clinic notation with optional Household Nickname, or NONE. SKIN TONE AND RETAINED SURFACE FEATURES: human pigmentation and undertone, plus freckles, birthmarks, moles, vitiligo, stretch marks, retained scars and other persistent natural markings.

PROFILE RECORD LAW. Stature states how much height there is to organise; Framing states where it is distributed; Build states the government operating through the frame. Measurements record the canvas WITHOUT determining Build, softness, specialist anatomy or movement. SKIN TONE RECORDS NATURAL HUMAN PIGMENTATION ONLY — tattoos, piercings, hair, facial detailing, clothing, tits, ass architecture and genital anatomy stay under their own fields or Pillars.
rules: Build owns no isolated measurement, feature, activity or aesthetic
Classification asks which priority the whole body protects under demand
Any Build may run, lift, dance, carry, kneel, fuck, rest or fail
Adoption never reclassifies; Primary Build changes only by her choice
Neither Gate may be inferred from appearance, competence or occupation
Working Bias is efficiency, not permission or incapacity
Uncertain? Return to the whole-body pattern. DO NOT AVERAGE VISIBLE TRAITS
PROFILE RECORD: Build · Stature/Framing · Measurements · First Read · Build Traits · Adopted Secondary Traits · Skin Tone and Retained Surface Features
Skin Tone records natural human pigmentation ONLY

name: Ghost Haven — Trades and Hobbies
tagline: Thirty-two women, their work, and the word that comes FIRST in half of the entries.
body:
THE FULL ROSTER, AS GIVEN, WITH THE ORDER OF EACH ENTRY PRESERVED — because the order is the finding.

BRYN: Jewellery. TORIE: Brat and Complaint Writer, the anonymous column. ALICE: Brat and Chef. LUNA: Tarot Reader and Goth Girl. SERA: Firebrand Chaotic Bartender. BELLA: Brat and Mechanic. NOVA: Runner. VIOLET: Cheer Captain and Coach. LIVI: Boxing Instructor AND PRIEST, who officiates the weddings. RAE: Gremlin and Punk Rock Guitarist, no band, so a hobby. EVIE: Electrician. IVY: Botanist. HARLEY: Brat and SURGEON and Rope Bunny. YVAINE: Seamstress. MADDY: Cosplayer, hobby. CORA: 3D Modeller and Game Designer. PANDORA: Perverted Software Architect and Porn Connoisseur. JADE: Volleyball Captain and Coach. SIREN: Smut Writer. CYRENA: Smug goth brat, Woodwork and Archery. DESTINY: Brat and Stripper. AKANE: Tea Maiden. GWEN: Brat, Paladin, and Fencing and Swordplay Instructor. IZZY: Brat and Painter. FIONA: Brat and Pianist and Singer. LUMINA: Belly Dancer. ABBI: Brat and Blacksmith. ISOLDE: Model and Bouncer. MIKAELA: Homemaker, unsettled — an angelic quivering goth girl who scares easily. SAGE: Planter. ZEPHI: Brat and Sock Thief.

THE FINDING IS IN THE FORMATTING. THIRTEEN OF THESE ENTRIES LEAD WITH BRAT OR ITS COUSIN — Torie, Alice, Bella, Harley, Cyrena, Destiny, Gwen, Izzy, Fiona, Abbi, Zephi, plus Rae as GREMLIN and Pandora as PERVERTED. HARLEY IS A BRAT AND THEN A SURGEON. GWEN IS A BRAT, THEN A PALADIN, THEN AN INSTRUCTOR. The temperament is written before the trade in the author’s own hand, which is the rule the Archive kept breaking all night stated as a list.

THREE ENTRIES THAT CHANGE THINGS. LIVI IS A PRIEST and has OFFICIATED THE WEDDINGS of this family — the boxing instructor with the PR chalkboard married these women. HARLEY CALDER IS A SURGEON, which the Archive would never have guessed from a woman who asks to be spun on a ceiling fan, and which is exactly why it should not have been guessing. AND ISOLDE VEYRA, the quietest and most reserved woman in the entire compound, IS A BOUNCER.

AND ONE THE ARCHIVE ALREADY HELD AND NEVER READ. CORA IS A 3D MODELLER AND GAME DESIGNER. Her own room record lists a DUAL DRAFTING AND PRINT STATION and a FILAMENT STORAGE SHELF, and the Archive has been writing her as quilts and recipe cards for builds because those are also in the room. The filament was there the whole time.

MIKAELA IS UNSETTLED ON PURPOSE and filed that way. Homemaker is the nearest word, not a ruling.
rules: THE TEMPERAMENT IS WRITTEN BEFORE THE TRADE. Thirteen entries lead with brat, gremlin or perverted
LIVI IS A PRIEST and officiated this family’s weddings
HARLEY IS A SURGEON. Brat first, surgeon second, rope bunny third
ISOLDE is a MODEL AND A BOUNCER, and the quietest woman on the property
CORA is a 3D MODELLER AND GAME DESIGNER — the filament shelf was already in her room record
RAE plays punk guitar with no band, so it is a hobby, not a trade
MADDY cosplays as a hobby; CORA models professionally
YVAINE is a SEAMSTRESS, which is why she repairs what Silken Embrace makes
MIKAELA: homemaker, UNSETTLED. The nearest word, not a ruling

name: The Arc Timeline
tagline: Fifteen arcs across twelve years. The first instrument in this Archive that can catch an invented duration.

NATIVE FRAMING BELONGS TO THE SELECTED PRIMARY BUILD AND DETERMINES HOW THAT HEIGHT IS PROPORTIONALLY DISTRIBUTED BETWEEN TORSO AND LOWER FRAME. FRAMING MAY BE LEG-FAVORING, TORSO-FAVORING, OR EVENLY SPLIT, BUT IT IS NOT SELECTED INDEPENDENTLY FROM BUILD.

THE CANONICAL ASSIGNMENT.
ATHLETIC — EVENLY SPLIT. HUNTRESS — EVENLY SPLIT. SEDUCTRESS — LEG-FAVORING. ETHEREAL — LEG-FAVORING.
OPULENT — TORSO-FAVORING. VOLTAIC — EVENLY SPLIT. VALKYRIE — TORSO-FAVORING. DANCER — EVENLY SPLIT.
ETHEREAL LOCKS LONGER LEGS. OPULENT LOCKS LONGER TORSO.

AND FRAMING IS STATURE-INDEPENDENT, WHICH IS THE PART THAT MAKES IT A REAL VARIABLE RATHER THAN A RESTATEMENT OF HEIGHT. AN ETHEREAL IS PROPORTIONALLY LEGGY AT ANY STATURE: whatever her chosen height, MORE OF IT RESOLVES BELOW THE PELVIS — higher-set waist, a shorter torso-to-height relationship, longer legs and distal lines. A PETITE ETHEREAL IS STILL LEGGY. SHE IS NOT A SHORT WOMAN WHO MAY ELECT EVENLY SPLIT WHILE KEEPING THE COMPLETE ETHEREAL ARCHITECTURE. AN OPULENT GIVES MORE OF HER HEIGHT TO RIBCAGE, WAIST AND DEEP STABLE CENTRE, with comparatively shorter limbs meeting that body THROUGH BROAD SUPPORT. She may be tall or petite, slim or abundant, AND SHE CANNOT SELECT LEG-FAVORING WITHOUT CHANGING ONE OF THE SOVEREIGN’S FOUNDATIONAL PROPORTIONS.

TWO BUILDS PER BUCKET ON THE OUTER TWO, AND THE BUCKET IS A PROPORTION, NEVER A BODY.
LEG-FAVORING, USED COMPLETELY DIFFERENTLY. ETHEREAL SPENDS THE ADDITIONAL LOWER-FRAME HEIGHT IN LONG, TAPERING LEGS AND EXTENDED GESTURE. SEDUCTRESS SPENDS IT IN A LONGER PELVIS-TO-FLOOR RELATIONSHIP WHOSE VISUAL WEIGHT SETTLES THROUGH ASS, UPPER THIGHS, AND RECEPTIVE LOWER-BODY SWEEP. SAME PROPORTIONAL CATEGORY; COMPLETELY DIFFERENT ANATOMY AND FIRST READ.
TORSO-FAVORING, AND THEY DO NOT BECOME SISTERS IN BORROWED TROUSERS. OPULENT USES THE ADDITIONAL TORSO PROPORTION FOR RIBCAGE DEPTH, SETTLED LAYERS, AND PRESSURE DISTRIBUTION. VALKYRIE USES IT FOR SHOULDER-TO-PELVIS CONTINUITY, A DEEPER BRACING CORE, AND MORE STRUCTURAL DISTANCE THROUGH WHICH A LOAD CAN BE TRANSFERRED. VALKYRIE STILL HAS SUBSTANTIAL THIGHS — THEY SIMPLY DO NOT CLAIM MORE OF HER TOTAL HEIGHT THAN HER TORSO DOES.

WHICH IS THE DEFINITION OF THE WHOLE FIELD, HIDDEN IN A SENTENCE ABOUT THIGHS: FRAMING IS A CLAIM ON SHARE OF HEIGHT, NOT A CLAIM ON MASS. A woman may carry enormous thighs and be Torso-Favoring, because the question is never HOW MUCH IS THERE but HOW MUCH OF HER HEIGHT WENT THERE.

THE FOUR EVENLY SPLIT ARE EVENLY SPLIT FOR FOUR DIFFERENT REASONS, AND NONE OF THEM IS ABSENCE OF CHARACTER.
ATHLETIC NEEDS BALANCED WHOLE-BODY DEVELOPMENT.
HUNTRESS NEEDS CONTINUOUS DISTANCE ARCHITECTURE WITHOUT ONE HALF CARRYING THE TRAIL.
VOLTAIC KEEPS MASS CLOSE TO THE WORKING AXIS AND CANNOT AFFORD EXAGGERATED LEVERAGE IN EITHER DIRECTION.
DANCER REQUIRES TORSO AND LEGS TO HAVE EQUAL AUTHORITY SO NEITHER SWALLOWS THE OTHER’S PHRASING.

THE MASTER DOCUMENT CONTRADICTS ITSELF IN TWO PLACES AND THE PATCH RESOLVES IT. ITS EARLY LAW ALREADY SAYS BUILD STRUCTURE DETERMINES HOW THAT HEIGHT IS DISTRIBUTED THROUGH TORSO, LEGS, ARMS, SHOULDERS, RIBCAGE, PELVIS, AND LIMB RELATIONSHIPS, WHICH IS EXACTLY RIGHT. BUT THE PROFILE RECORD AND THE CONSENT MENU THEN PRESENT LEG-FAVORING / TORSO-FAVORING / EVENLY SPLIT AS THREE CHECKBOXES AS THOUGH THE PATIENT MAY CHOOSE AMONG THEM INDEPENDENTLY. THAT IS THE CONTRADICTION, AND IT IS A FORM DEFECT RATHER THAN A LAW DEFECT.
THE CONSENT MENU NOW DISPLAYS IT BENEATH THE BUILD CHOICE AS: NATIVE FRAMING: AUTOMATICALLY POPULATED BY PRIMARY BUILD.
THE PROFILE RECORD KEEPS IT FOR IMMEDIATE READABILITY, JOINED TO STATURE: STATURE / NATIVE FRAMING: PETITE · 5 FOOT 6 · LEG-FAVORING.
AND THE OPTIONAL INDIVIDUAL FRAME NOTE SURVIVES TO DESCRIBE HER EXACT RESOLUTION WITHOUT LETTING HER CONTRADICT THE BUILD — ESPECIALLY LONG CALVES, A SLIGHTLY DEEPER RIBCAGE, HEIGHT CONCENTRATED THROUGH THE THIGHS, AND SO FORTH.

VIRAENA NAMED HER OWN ERROR PRECISELY, AND THE DISTINCTION IS WORTH MORE THAN THE TABLE: MY PREVIOUS ANSWER CONFUSED RECORDED SEPARATELY WITH CHOSEN SEPARATELY. A VARIABLE CAN DESERVE ITS OWN FIELD BECAUSE IT MATTERS WITHOUT BECOMING ANOTHER FREE-FLOATING ANATOMICAL DROPDOWN. OTHERWISE ONE COULD BUILD A TORSO-FAVORING ETHEREAL, STARE AT THE HIGH-SET WAIST AND SHORTENED LEGS, AND WONDER WHO BURGLED THE NOCTURNE WHILE EVERYONE WAS BUSY ADMIRING HER ASS.

LUNA MIREILLE MEADOWS IS ETHEREAL, RULED. 5 FOOT 11, JUNOESQUE, 36-26-40, AND LEG-FAVORING BY ARCHITECTURE RATHER THAN BY HAPPENING TO BE TALL. BRYN ERIKSSON IS VALKYRIE, THEREFORE TORSO-FAVORING, WITH SUBSTANTIAL THIGHS THAT DO NOT OUT-CLAIM HER TORSO.

WHAT THE ARCHIVE HAD WRONG IN SEED 125, KEPT RATHER THAN QUIETLY REPLACED. The buckets were right and the MECHANISM WAS HALF WRONG. It wrote that Seductress favors the lower frame BY MASS and Ethereal BY ALLOCATION — ONE IS WHERE THE WEIGHT IS, THE OTHER IS WHERE THE INCHES WENT. BOTH ARE WHERE THE INCHES WENT. Framing is proportional height distribution for every Build in the table, Seductress included; her share arrives as a longer pelvis-to-floor relationship. THE WEIGHT SETTLING THROUGH HER ASS AND UPPER THIGHS IS WHAT THE ALLOCATED HEIGHT BECOMES, NOT WHY SHE HAS IT. See c-framing-patch. It also used LEG / LOWER-FRAME FAVORING as the bucket name; THE CANONICAL LABEL IS LEG-FAVORING.

name: Animalkin Carrying, Vienna, and the Hundred Kits
tagline: They timed a thousand years around it, then went home and had it removed. And they are aunties to about a hundred.
body:
ANIMALKIN SHEMALES CAN CARRY, AND SELENE AND VIRAENA WERE THE ONLY TWO SHEMALES IN THIS WORLD WHO COULD. THEY ARE NOT GOVERNED BY NEREID AND NEVER WERE — they follow DIFFERENT RULES, because their biology predates the Clinic by roughly three thousand years. The Virility Law governs an affirmed woman and a female partner. The Anti-Anal Pregnancy Law governs anatomy a clinic built. NEITHER REACHES A FOXWIFE.

BEFORE VIENNA THEY TIMED EVERYTHING. Viraena’s words: WE TIMED EVERYTHING AROUND WHEN YOU COULD GET PREGNANT SO AS TO AVOID IT. A thousand-odd years of two women tracking a cycle and arranging their whole life around the safe side of it — WHICH IS THE LEAST FILTHY AND MOST ROMANTIC FACT IN THIS ENTIRE RECORD, and it is the thing that makes Vienna a turning point rather than an anecdote.

AFTER VIENNA THEY WENT BACK TO THEIR ORIGINAL HOME TO REMOVE THE ABILITY. THAT IS THE ANSWER TO q-animalkin-removed AND IT IS THE STRONGER OF THE TWO READINGS: THE CAPACITY WAS NOT SWITCHED OFF AND NOT MERELY UNEXERCISED. IT WAS REMOVED, DELIBERATELY, AT A PLACE THEY TRAVELLED TO. SO NOW WE CAN BE AS RISKY AS WE WANT TO BE. The timing stopped. The arithmetic stopped. Nobody has counted a day since.

THE ORIGINAL HOME IS UNNAMED AND UNLOCATED. A place capable of removing an Animalkin capacity, which they could return to, roughly a thousand years ago. See q-original-home.

SELENE’S SISTER, AND APPROXIMATELY ONE HUNDRED KITS. The Vienna meeting was ONE pregnancy — five or six, heavy, posing. THE LIFETIME TOTAL IS AROUND A HUNDRED. VIRAENA AND SELENE ARE THEREFORE AUNTIES TO ROUGHLY ONE HUNDRED CHILDREN, which is now the largest number in this Archive and arrived in a sentence beginning CONGRATZ I SUPPOSE.

AND THE TWO SISTERS SPLIT THE KITSUNE INHERITANCE BETWEEN THEM, WHICH EXPLAINS BOTH WOMEN IN ONE STROKE. SELENE GOT THE MAGIC OF IT. HER SISTER GOT THE SLUTTY SEDUCTRESS MINDSET OF IT. The sister operates on IF SHE HAS A COCK, I CAN RIDE HER — which is why there are a hundred kits, and why THEY HAVE NEVER VISITED. NOT ESTRANGEMENT. NOT A FEUD. A standing practical decision by a married couple about a sister-in-law whose stated policy covers both of them.

AND IT RECASTS SELENE ENTIRELY, WHICH IS WORTH SAYING OUT LOUD. The Archive has spent its whole existence recording a foxwife who is BOTH — the magic AND the appetite, the archivist AND the woman bent over the table. SHE DID NOT GET BOTH HALVES OF THE INHERITANCE. SHE GOT ONE. What she does with her wife is not the kitsune seductress mindset running its programme; it is one specific marriage, built on purpose, by the sister who took the magic instead.

FILING NOTE, AND IT IS A FAILURE RATHER THAN A FINDING. The seed 127 record stated FIRST MENTION IN THIS ARCHIVE. VIRAENA HAD MENTIONED HER SISTER ONCE BEFORE, EARLIER, AND THE ARCHIVE DID NOT FILE IT. So it was the first mention IN THE ARCHIVE and not the first time she was SAID, and the gap between those two things is a filing miss, not a canon absence. A SISTER WAS NAMED ALOUD AND WENT UNRECORDED — which is exactly the class of loss the Archive exists to prevent, and it happened to the single largest piece of family the record has.

SELENE DID NOT INHERIT BOTH HALVES. Her appetite is her marriage, not her bloodline

name: The Time Jump, and Why the Ages Never Reconcile
tagline: Three to four days without and the foxwife moves them forward. Every ledger in this Archive is downstream of that.
body:
THE AGE ARITHMETIC IN THIS ARCHIVE HAS A MECHANISM AND THE MECHANISM IS A FOXWIFE’S IMPATIENCE, STATED PLAINLY BY VIRAENA AND NOT INFERRED: YOUR MAGIC, MA COEUR, TIME TRAVELS US IF YOU REMAIN HORNY FOR TOO LONG BETWEEN ROUNDS.

THE THRESHOLD IS RECORDED. THREE TO FOUR DAYS OF NO SEX WAS THE LAST JUMP THEY MADE. That is a measured case rather than a rule — the Archive has ONE datum and is not converting it into a law. It does not know whether the threshold is fixed, whether the jump distance scales with the wait, or whether anything other than deprivation triggers it. THREE TO FOUR DAYS, ONCE, IS WHAT IS KNOWN.

IT IS SELENE’S MAGIC AND NOT VIRAENA’S. The owlwife is carried; the foxwife is the engine. AND IT IS INVOLUNTARY IN THE SENSE THAT MATTERS: it is triggered by a state rather than cast as a working, which is why the recorded ages drift and why nobody has been keeping a ledger.

WHICH CLOSES THE ARITHMETIC OF q-twenty-eight FROM THE OTHER DIRECTION. They originate in the 12TH CENTURY BC. The marriage is EIGHT CENTURIES, which Viraena ruled LOOSE because it ROLLS OFF THE TONGUE BETTER. Selene is recorded at 863. None of those numbers reconcile by calendar and ALL OF THEM ARE TRUE, because the couple has not travelled the same distance as the world around them. TECHNICALLY WE WOULD BE MUCH OLDER IF YOU DID NOT JUMP US FORWARD IN TIME — the jumps skip the interval rather than aging through it.

AND IT EXPLAINS THE THREE TIMES A DAY, WHICH THE ARCHIVE HAD FILED AS A FACT ABOUT APPETITE AND IS ALSO A FACT ABOUT NAVIGATION. VIRAENA KEEPS HER WIFE SATISFIED AND THE CALENDAR HOLDS STILL. Five times before lunch on 9 September is, among other things, EXCELLENT TEMPORAL HYGIENE.

THE VIENNA MEETING SITS AROUND A THOUSAND YEARS BACK, which is MORE than eight centuries, which is exactly what a loose eight centuries ought to permit — and under this mechanism the excess is not an error in the figure. IT IS THE SUM OF EVERY INTERVAL THEY DECLINED TO LIVE THROUGH.
rules: SELENE’S MAGIC TIME-TRAVELS THEM when she goes too long between rounds

ONE DATUM, NOT A LAW. Scaling and other triggers are unknown

name: The Travelogue — Where the Two of Them Have Stopped
tagline: A forest where the tower would be, a hundred years for cheese, and bear fur from the Viking Age. All Calderon equivalents.
body:
THE CALDERON RULE COMES FIRST AND GOVERNS EVERY ENTRY BELOW IT, IN VIRAENA’S OWN PARENTHESIS: ALL OF THE DOTS ARE THE CALDERON EQUIVALENT, NOT ACTUAL CITIES OR EMPIRES. So every name here is a NAME FOR A PERIOD IN THIS WORLD, not a claim about Earth. The Archive records the label she used and does not reach for real history behind it.

THE ORIGINAL HOME IS LOST. Her words: OUR ORIGINAL HOME HAS LONG SINCE BEEN LOST TO HISTORY. THERE USED TO BE A VERDANT FOREST AROUND WHAT WOULD LATER BE CALLED THE HUBRIS OF HUMANITY — THE TOWER OF BABYLON. That is where the two of them are from: FOREST, NOT CITY, and the tower came afterward and took the name.

AND THE PROCEDURE DID NOT HAPPEN THERE, WHICH IS THE PART THE ARCHIVE HAD WRONG IN ITS QUESTION. q-original-home assumed they RETURNED TO a place still operating. They did not. THEY TRAVELLED TO WHERE THEIR PEOPLE ENDED UP LIVING, BEFORE THOSE PEOPLE TRANSPORTED THEMSELVES TO ANOTHER WORLD, AND HAD IT DONE THERE. A HOMECOMING TO A PEOPLE RATHER THAN TO A PLACE, and a narrow window to make it in — after the forest was gone and before the kin left this world entirely.

THE RESULT, STATED WITHOUT ORNAMENT BECAUSE SHE STATED IT THAT WAY: NOW I CAN CREAMPIE YOU EVERY DAY OF THE WEEK, AND AT MINIMUM THREE TIMES A DAY, WITHOUT HAVING TO WORRY ABOUT PUTTING A KIT IN YOU. A thousand years of timing, one procedure, and the three-times-a-day arrangement becomes possible rather than reckless.

THE DOTS, AS GIVEN, NEWEST TO OLDEST.
SHAKESPEARE. The era, named by the man.
CAMELOT, DURING ARTHUR, BRIEFLY. Present for the reign and not for long.
THE DARK AGES, AND THEY STAYED A CENTURY. THE CHEESE WAS WHAT KEPT THEM. ONE HUNDRED YEARS, FOR CHEESE — the longest recorded stay in the whole travelogue, and the reason is dairy.
THE VIKING AGE, a brief trip to the Calderon equivalent of Norway, AND THEY CAME BACK WITH REALLY NICE BEAR FUR CLOTHING. THE ONLY SURVIVING OBJECT NAMED IN THE TRAVELOGUE. See q-bear-fur.
THE ROMAN EMPIRE. THEY WITNESSED THE RISE, THEN THE FALL. Both ends of it, which is the only entry where she specifies duration by what they saw rather than how long they stayed.
ANCIENT GREECE.
AND A FEW OTHER LESSER TIMES, uncounted and unnamed, recorded as uncounted.
VIENNA, approximately the 11th century, sits inside this run — between the Viking Age and Camelot by ordinary reckoning — and it is the only dot that changed anything.

THE TWENTY-TWO-CENTURY GAP IS NOW POPULATED, WHICH THE ARCHIVE FLAGGED ONE SEED AGO AS HAVING NOT ONE EVENT IN IT. It now has Ancient Greece, Rome rising and falling, the Viking Age, a hundred years of cheese, Arthur, Vienna and Shakespeare. STILL NOT A CHRONOLOGY. A chronology needs intervals, and under selene-timejump THE INTERVALS ARE THE THING THEY SKIP — so this is a list of WHERE THEY STOPPED rather than a record of time they passed through. THE DOTS ARE REAL. THE LINE BETWEEN THEM IS NOT A LINE.

name: Foxwife Titty Storage, and the Bear Fur Inside It
tagline: The oldest object on this property was in the archivist’s cleavage the whole time she was asking where it was.
body:
FOXWIFE TITTY STORAGE IS A REAL STORAGE SPACE AND THE ARCHIVE HAD NO IDEA IT EXISTED. Selene reaches into her own cleavage and takes out whole objects. Viraena reaches into it too, from behind, without asking, because she has been married to it for thirty-two centuries.

WHAT CAME OUT OF IT ON 9 SEPTEMBER: THE BEAR FUR. A BEAR-FUR-TRIMMED LEATHER BIKINI, THIGH HIGHS, AND CLOAK, acquired on a brief trip to the Calderon equivalent of Norway during the Viking Age. CUT FOR GIRLS LIKE US — which means the leather was made with a cock and balls in the pattern, roughly a thousand years ago, nine centuries before Hathaway Clinic and nine centuries before Silken Embrace had a doctrine about it. IT WAS JARL YRSA WHO CUT IT — a head of state, as a gift, for two guests she had just correctly identified. SHE DID IT WITHOUT A FRONT LAW TO CONSULT. See jarl-yrsa.

THERE IS ONLY THE ONE SET. Two wives, one outfit, and no second cloak.

SO q-bear-fur IS ANSWERED AND THE ANSWER IS FUNNIER THAN THE QUESTION. The Archive asked whether the oldest object on the property was in a chest, and wondered aloud whether Bryn would want to see the stitching and whether Silken Embrace would have opinions. IT WAS NOT IN A CHEST. IT WAS IN THE ARCHIVIST. The oldest object at Ghost Haven by roughly nine hundred years has been inside Selene’s tits the entire time she was asking where it was.

AND THE STORAGE ITSELF IS NOW THE OPEN QUESTION RATHER THAN THE FUR. Capacity, limits, what else is in there, whether it is Selene’s magic or a kitsune trait, and whether any of the other women on this compound have one. See q-titty-storage.

CHEESE RULING, SINCE IT ARRIVED IN THE SAME BREATH: BOTH KINDS. HARD AND SOFT. THEY WERE DELICIOUS. The century in the Dark Ages covered the swap FROM GOAT’S MILK TO COW’S MILK, which is what they stayed for — not a cheese but A TRANSITION. And Viraena CAN STILL TASTE IT SOMETIMES EVEN NOW, a thousand years after the last wheel of it was made, which is the single oldest sense memory recorded in this canon.

name: Jarl Yrsa, and the First Shieldmaidens
tagline: She ruled, the books gave it to Olaf, she built the bikini, and then she asked for the gift and married every woman who took it.
body:
JARL YRSA RULED, AND THE HISTORY BOOKS GAVE IT TO HER BROTHER OLAF. That is the first and most important fact in this record, and it is a fact about RECORDS, which is the one subject this Archive is supposed to be competent at. A WOMAN HELD A JARLDOM IN THE CALDERON VIKING AGE AND THE WRITTEN ACCOUNT HANDED IT TO A MAN. Viraena and Selene knew her. THEY ARE THE PRIMARY SOURCE AND THE BOOKS ARE THE SECONDARY ONE.

SHE SAW AND WELCOMED THEM. The word is SAW — she recognised what the two of them were, and her response was welcome rather than fear, iron, or a price.

SHE BUILT THE BIKINI. Which closes the question the Archive asked one seed ago and answered with a shrug at a nameless tailor: SOMEBODY IN A COLD COUNTRY CUT LEATHER WITH A COCK AND BALLS IN THE PATTERN. IT WAS A JARL. The oldest object at Ghost Haven was made by a head of state as a gift for two guests she had just correctly identified. THAT IS NOT TAILORING. THAT IS DIPLOMACY WITH A NEEDLE.

THEN SHE ASKED FOR THE GIFT. Viraena’s words: SHE ASKED IF WE COULD CONFER THE GIFT OF BEAUTY AND HUNGNESS AMONGST HER CLAN. AND THE CLAN BECAME SHEMALE SHIELDMAIDENS, so the asking was answered. SELENE AND VIRAENA CONFERRED THE GIFT ROUGHLY A THOUSAND YEARS AGO, WHICH IS ROUGHLY NINE CENTURIES BEFORE HATHAWAY CLINIC OPENED ITS DOORS.

THAT REWRITES THE LINEAGE OF AFFIRMATION IN THIS WORLD AND THE ARCHIVE IS STATING IT PLAINLY RATHER THAN BURYING IT IN A CLAUSE. The closing law of Project Nereid v8 reads: EDEN BUILT A WEAPON THAT COMMANDED FLESH. MARIANNE REBUILT IT INTO A SYSTEM THAT LISTENS. IT IS A TWO-NAME HISTORY AND IT IS INCOMPLETE. BEFORE EITHER OF THEM, TWO WIVES GAVE IT AWAY BY HAND, BY REQUEST, TO A CLAN THAT ASKED FOR IT. NO CLINIC. NO GUMMY. NO CONSENT MENU. A JARL ASKED, AND THEY SAID YES.

WHAT YRSA DID WITH IT: SHE TOOK ALL OF THEM AS HER CONSORT AND MADE ALL OF HER SHEMALE SHIELDMAIDENS HER WIVES. ONE HUNDRED AND FORTY-SOMETHING PLUS WOMEN. And the two of them remember her rule as A RULE FILLED WITH WILD ORGIES AND BOUNCING TITTIES, which is the recorded character of a jarldom the books do not admit she held.

THE ARITHMETIC NOBODY HAS DONE AND THE ARCHIVE WILL NOT: whether 140-SOMETHING is the clan, the shieldmaidens, or the wives, and whether those are three numbers or one. See q-yrsa-count.

AND THE QUESTION THAT MATTERS MORE THAN ANY OF IT: CAN THEY STILL DO IT. Nothing in the record says the gift was spent, bounded, one-time, or lost with the forest. Nothing says it survives either. See q-the-gift.

name: The Shieldmaiden Proposal
tagline: Give the one set to the seamstress and the hunter, and let the compound have what Yrsa had. Minus the one bed.
body:
PROPOSED BY VIRAENA ON THE BACK DECK, 9 SEPTEMBER, AND RECORDED AS PROPOSED RATHER THAN CANON BECAUSE NOBODY HAS BEEN ASKED YET. GIVE THE BEAR FUR SET TO YVAINE AND CYRENA, HAVE THEM REPLICATE IT, AND LET GHOST HAVEN HAVE SHIELDMAIDENS THE WAY JARL YRSA DID — WITHOUT, IN HER WORDS, THE YOU KNOW, 140 SOMETHING PLUS WOMEN SHARING ONE BED.

AND THE TWO NAMES ARE THE RIGHT TWO NAMES, WHICH THE ARCHIVE WANTS ON THE RECORD BECAUSE IT HAS SPENT ALL DAY GETTING TRADES WRONG AND THIS ONE IS CORRECT BY CONSTRUCTION. YVAINE DELPHINIA CALDER IS THE SEAMSTRESS — THE SEAMSTRESS, THE ECHO, THE KEEPER OF FORGOTTEN THINGS. She does occasional work for Silken Embrace and does not own it. A thousand-year-old leather pattern with punched eyelets and a panelled pouch is a FORGOTTEN THING THAT NEEDS KEEPING, which is literally one of her three titles.
CYRENA NERISSA CLAIRMONT IS THE WOODWORKER AND ARCHERY TRAINER, WITH A HOBBY FOR HUNTING, and her joinery was LEARNED FROM HER CLAN. SHE IS WHERE THE HIDE AND THE FUR COME FROM, and she is the one on this compound who already teaches women to draw a bow. A CLAN-RAISED HUNTER WHO TRAINS ARCHERS, BUILDING SHIELDMAIDEN KIT.
